tei:div.tei:p: "$ ༄༅// snyan rgyud yid bzhin nor bu'i smin lam rgyas pa dngos grub gan mdzod ces bya ba bzhugs so//

༄༅// gang gi snying ga bla ma'i bka' drin bdud rtsis brlan pas gdod ma'i son// ma lus pa 'di dkyil 'khor chen po'i pad+mar kha 'bus de rgyas pa// dbang bskur mchog gi sbrang rtsi'i gnas gyur rdo rje'i sar chas rkang drug pa'i// dpyid kyi dpal der phyag byas nas ni bde legs dri bsung ci dgar 'gyed// 'dir dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i snyan brgyud kyi smin lam yid bzhin nor bu las cho ga rgyas pa la mos pa dag gi ngor phyag bzhes su mdzad pa de bshad par bya'o/ de yang sngon du 'gro ba dang*/ dngos gzhi/ rjes gsum las sngon 'gro/ sa chog /sta gon gyi rim pa/ thig tshon gyi cho ga rnams zur du dbyes pa las shes par bya zhing*/ gnas brgyan te sgrub pa ni/ bris zin pa'i dal 'khor gyi steng du bla re la sogs lda ldi mda' dar ral gri brgyad dang me long tshon skud kyi dra ba bya/ bum pa dgu na gtso bum dbus de'i steng du rnam rgyal chen po/ gzhan brgyad sgo'i g.yas g.yon/ las thams cad pa shar sgo dang nye ba'i mañdzi'i khar bzhag /mthar shog bskor mchod pa'i yo byad ci 'byor ba bsham/ slob dpon phyag rgya drug dang ldan pa'i he ru ka'i chas su zhugs pa'i mdun du chang dang*/ gtor ma dang tshogs kyi 'khor lor 'os pa'i yo byad thams cad tshang ba'i bar ro// bde ba'i stan la 'dug pas/ de ltar bdag nyid rab bsrung zhing*// sngags dang phyag rgyas rnams brgyan nas// dngos grub chen po rab ster ba'i// dkyil 'khor 'jigs pa bri bar bya// zhes dang*/ de nas bum pa bca' ba ni// zhes go rim bzhin gsungs pas/ dang po bskyed rim rgyas pa bzhin bzlas pa'i bar bya/ de nas rdul tshon nam ras bris/ oṃ khaṇ+ḍa ro hi hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ kyis bsangs/ oṃ shū n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ ras bris sam rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor 'di nyid/ e las chos 'byung gru gsum phyi dkar la nang dmar ba'i nang du yaṃ raṃ baṃ laṃ yongs su gyur pa las rlung gi dkyil 'khor nag po zla gam/

me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum/ chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po/ sa'i dkyil 'khor ser po gru bzhi brtsegs pa'i steng du/ suṃ ljang khu las ri rab gyi rtse mor/ paṃ las sna tshogs pad+mar hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje rgya gram gyi lte ba la/ bh+rūm̐ las rnam snang rig ma dang bcas pa 'od du zhu ba'i rin po che sna tshogs kyi khang pa brtsegs pa/ gru bzhi sgo bzhi rgyan rta babs la sogs pa mtshan nyid tshang ba dur khrod brgyad kyis bskor ba/ nang phyogs mdog can gyi dbus su bde chen gyi 'khor lo sdong bu dang bcas gyen du 'phags pa'i rin po che'i pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa phyogs dmar mtshams ser nag ljang mthing ka /mu khyud gri gug gi phreng ba can gyi lte bar nyi gdan la 'jigs byed nag po lag pa bzhi pa'i ro kha bub pa dang*/ dus mtshan ma gson mo gan rkyal bsgyel ba/ pad+ma'i 'og gi nam mkhar mkha' spyod kyi yul brgyad kyi rang bzhin/ thugs kyi 'khor lo sngon po rdo rje'i mu khyud can/ sa gzhi'i thad du sa spyod kyi yul brgyad kyi rang bzhin gsung gi 'khor lo dmar po pad+ma'i mu khyud can sa 'og tu sa 'og spyod kyi yul brgyad kyi rang bzhin sku'i 'khor lo dkar po 'khor lo'i mu khyud can/ thams cad rtsibs brgyad pa lha gnas thams cad du nyi ma dang ro gdan/ lte ba'i gdan gyi steng du bcom ldan 'das dpal 'khor lo sdom pa/ in dra nī la dang mtshungs pa'i sku mdog sngon po zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis pa zhabs g.yas brkyang bas dus mtshan ma dmar mo'i nu ma mnan pa/ g.yon cung zad bskum pas 'jigs byed sngon po'i dpral ba mnan pa/ rtsa zhal sngon po/ g.yon zhal ljang khu/ rgyab zhal dmar po/ g.yas zhal ser po/ zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ nor bu dang sna tshogs rdo rje dang zla ba phyed pas mtshan pa'i ral pa'i thor tshugs can/ dbu re re la mi mgo skam po lnga lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/

rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal byas pa/ 'khor lo dang*/ rna cha dang*/ mgul rgyan dang*/ gdu bu dang*/ ska rags dang*/ thal chen te phyag rgya drug gis brgyan pa/ zhal mche ba gtsigs shing 'jigs par byed pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan pa ste/ sku dpa' ba dang*/ sgeg pa dang*/ 'jigs su rung ba dang*/ gsung rgod pa dang*/ gshe ba dang*/ rngam pa dang*/ thugs snying rje ba dang*/ zhi ba dang ngo mtshar ba'o// phyag bcu gnyis kyis spras pa'i dang po gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ de'i 'og ma gnyis kyis glang po che'i pags pa rlon pa gdeng nas 'dzin pa/ g.yas kyi gsum pa na ḍā ma ru// bzhi pa na dgra s+t+wa/ lnga pa na gri gug /drug pa na mdung rtse gsum pa/ g.yon gyi gsum pa na kha ṭ+wāṃ ga /bzhi pa na thod pa khrag gis gang ba/ lnga pa na rdo rje'i zhags pa/ drug pa na tshangs pa'i mgo bo gdong bzhi pa bsnams pa/ de'i pang na yum rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/ in+t+ras gang ba'i thod pa 'dzin pa'i phyag g.yon pas yab la 'khyud pa/ g.yas rdo rje dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub steng gi nam mkha' la 'phyar ba/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ thod skam lnga bcu'i do shal byas pa gcer bu skra grol zhing phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ byin pa gnyis kyis bcom ldan 'das kyi brla gnyis la 'khyud pa/ gnyis ka'ang ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs par gyur/ shar gyi 'dab ma la mkha' 'gro ma sku mdog nag mo/ byang du lā ma ljang gu/ nub tu dum skyes ma dmar mo/ lhor gzugs can ma ser mo mtshams kyi 'dab ma bzhi la byang chub sems kyis gang ba'i bum pa bzhi'i steng du bdud rtsi lngas gang ba'i thod pa bzhi'o// lha mo de thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma g.yas gnyis gri gug dang ḍā ma ru/ g.yon gnyis thod pa dang kha ṭ+wām̐ ga 'dzin pa skra grol zhing phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/

zhabs g.yas brkyang bas pad nyi dang ro'i gdan la bzhugs pa/ thod pa dang rdo rje phreng bas dbu la brgyan pa/ mi mgo lnga cu'i do shal can sku drag mo'i gzugs can du gyur// thugs kyi 'khor lo'i rtsibs kyi phyogs g.yon skor du/ dpa' bo thod pa'i dum bu dang dpa' mo rab gtum ma/ keng rus chen po dang gtum pa'i mig can ma/ keng rus dang 'od ldan ma/ mche ba rnam par gtsigs pa dang sna chen ma/ me nas g.yas bskor gyis lha dgra dang dpa' bo'i blo gros ma/ 'od dpag med dang mi'u thung ma/ rdo rje'i 'od dang laṅka'i dbang phyug ma/ rdo rje'i lus dang shing grib ma rnams sngon po/ rim pa de nyid kyis gsung gi 'khor lo'i phyogs la/ myu gu can dang sa srungs ma/ rdo rje'i ral pa can dang 'jigs byed chen mo/ dpa' bo chen po dang rlung gi shugs can ma/ rdo rje hūm̐ mdzad dang chang 'thung ma/ mtshams su rab tu bzang po dang sngo bsangs mo/ rdo rje bzang po dang shin tu bzang mo/ 'jigs byed dang rta rna ma/ mig mi bzang dang bya gdong ma thams cad dmar po/ sku'i 'khor lo'i phyogs la stobs po che dang 'khor lo'i shugs can ma/ rin chen rdo rje dang dum skyes ma rta mgrin dang chang tshong ma/ nam mkha'i snying po dang 'khor lo'i go cha ma/ mtshams la he ru ka dang bzhin bzang ma/ pad+ma gar dbang dang stobs chen ma/ rnam par snang mdzad dang 'khor lo sgyur ma/ rdo rje sems dpa' dang brtson 'grus chen mo thams cad dkar po/ dpa' bo thams cad zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa thugs kyi g.yas rdo rje dang*/ gsung gi pad+ma sku'i 'khor lo/ g.yon de so sos yu ba byas pa'i dril bu bzung ste dpa' mo la 'khyud pa/ lhag ma gnyis ḍā ma ru dang khaṭ+wām̐ ga 'dzin pa/ spyan gsum pa ral pa'i thor tshugs can mi mgo skam po'i dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa'i do shal can phyag rgya drug gis brgyan te skyil krung phyed pa'i gar gyis bzhugs pa'i pang na dpa' mo rnams zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin cing skra grol ba phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa'o// shar sgor khwa gdong ma nag mo/

byang sgor 'ug gdong ma ljang gu nub sgor khyi gdong ma dmar mo/ lho sgor phag gdong ma ser mo/ shar lhor gshin rje brtan ma g.yas sngo g.yon ser ba/ lho nub tu gshin rje pho nya mo g.yas ser g.yon dmar ba/ nub byang du gshin rje mche ba can ma g.yas dmar g.yon ljang ba/ byang shar du gshin rje 'joms ma g.yas ljang g.yon sngo ba/ lha mo de thams cad zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma g.yas gnyis gri gug dang ḍā ma ru/ g.yon gnyis thod pa dang kha ṭ+wām̐ ga 'dzin pa/ gcer bu skra grol zhing phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang bas pad nyi dang ro'i gdan la bzhugs pa/ thod pa dang rdo rje phreng bas dbu la brgyan pa/ mi mgo lnga cu'i do shal can sku drag mo'i gzugs can du gyur// gtso bo dang lha mo rnams byang chub kyi phyogs so bdun so sen la sogs pa'i khams rnams dpa' bo nyer bzhir rnam par dag pa'o/ oṃ haḥ gtso bo'i snying gar rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po dkar ser dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas gsum rdo rje ḍā ma ru tshangs mgo /g.yon gsum dril bu thod pa kha ṭ+wām̐ ga bsnams pa/ na ma hi/ dpral bar rnam par snang mdzad ser po/ swa ha hu/ spyi bor rin chen 'byung gnas dmar po/ bau ṣaṭa he/ phrag pa gnyis la he ru ka nag po /hūm̐ hūm̐ hoḥ spyan gsum la 'od dpag med mthing ga /phaṭ haṃ/ yan lag thams cad la don yod grub pa ljang gu/ de thams cad zhal gcig phyag bzhi'i dang po gnyis/ 'khor lo/ rin po che/ rdo rje/ pad+ma/ sna tshogs rdo rje dang de'i dril bu thugs kar bsnol ba/ lhag ma gnyis ḍā ma ru dang thod pa/ dpa' bo'i chas kyis brgyan te g.yas brkyang gis bzhugs pa/ oṃ haḥ na ma hi/ swa ha hu/ bau ṣaṭahe/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hoḥphaṭ haṃ/ zhes brjod pas byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ baṃ/ yum gyi lte bar phag mo dmar mo dmar ljang ser ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas gsum gri gug kha ṭ+wām̐ ga /lcags kyu g.yon gsum thod pa/

tshangs mgo /zhags pa bsnams/ haṃ yoṃ snying gar gshin rje ma sngon mo/ hriṃ moṃ mgrin par rmongs byed ma dkar mo hriṃ hriṃ mtshog mar skyod byed ma ser mo/ hūm̐ hūm̐ spyi gtsug tu skrag byed ma ljang gu/ phaṭ phaṭ yan lag thams cad la tsaṇ+ḍi ka dud kha/ de thams cad zhal gcig phyag bzhi'i dang po gnyis gri gug dang thod pa/ lhag ma gnyis kha ṭ+wām̐ ga dang ḍā ma ru dpa' mo'i chas kyis brgyan te g.yon brkyang gis bzhugs pa/ oṃ baṃ/ haṃ yoṃ/ hriṃ moṃ/ hriṃ hriṃ/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ phaṭ phaṭ kyis byin gyis brlab bo/ 'bar ba'i phyag rgya mig g.yon gyi steng du bskor lta stangs der gtad rkang pa g.yas pas g.yon pa'i bol mnan/ snying kha'i 'od zer gyi lcags kyus bsgoms pa ji lta ba'i ye shes kyi 'khor lo dbang lha rigs lnga dang bcas pa pheṃ/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥdam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par gyur/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis mdun bskyed kyi lha la dbang bskur du gsol/ de dag gis spros pa'i gzugs ma rnams kyis bdud rtsi lngas gang ba'i bum pa 'dzin pas/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyi ni// lha rnams kun gyis khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yis// de bzhin dag pa'i sku khrus gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐ zhes pas dbang bskur bas/ chu de las byung ba'i rigs kyi bdag po gtso bo la mi bskyod pa/ yum la rnam snang*/ bde chen gyi lha mor rin 'byung*// thugs la mi bskyod pa/ gsung la snang mtha'/ sku la snang mdzad/ dam tshig la don grub/ sprul sku'i cha lugs can gyis dbu brgyan par gyur/ spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐ las 'od zer spros/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs bskul bas sems can gyi dug gsum sbyang bar mdzad de 'od zer dang lhan cig yi ge gsum la zhugs pas sku rdo rje gsung rdo rje thugs rdo rje rig ma dang bcas par gyur pa'i 'od kyis lus thams cad khyab par gyur

bar bdag bskyed ltar dang*/ mchod pa ni/ gal te dngos grub mchog 'dod na/ dri dang me tog de bzhin spos// cho ga bzhin du de bzhin mchod// mar me brgya yang dbul bya zhing*// zhes dang*/ rgyal mtshan dmar dang de bzhin ser// dkar dang nag dang ser skya dang*// me tog phreng ba du ma dang*// de bzhin gos ni sna tshogs dang*// bla bres dang ni yol ba dag /mdzes pa ji lta de bzhin ster// de bzhin bza' bca' btung ba yis// rab mnyam gzhag ste mchod par bya// zhes pa mchod pa thams cad kyis mchod par bya la/ de yang*/ mchod bzhi dpa' bo chen po ni// 'dod pa'i dngos grub sgrub byed pa// zhes 'byung bas/ snying ga nas spros pa'i mchod pa'i lha mo mchod rdzas bsam gyis mi khyab pa thogs pa rnams kyis/ oṃ shrī he ru ka pra war sat+ka ra ma hā ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha hūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ shrī he ru ka ma hā pa d+yaṃ ma ma tat+taṃ gṛh+ṇa sidhi m+me pra yats+tsha hūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ shrī he ru ka sa tut+ka pra tīts+tsha hūm̐ swā hā/ rgyas par spro na*/ dkyil 'khor kun tu rgyal ba mnyes byed pa// gzugs mdzes dkar mo rdo rje dril bu dang*// me tog spungs pa'i rin chen snod 'dzin ma// nam mkha' gang bas dkyil 'khor lha tshogs mchod// oṃ āḥbadz+ra puṣ+pe hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ dkyil 'khor kun tu rgyal ba mnyes byed pa// yid 'ong dud kha rdo rje dril bu dang*// bdug spos 'thul ba'i rin chen snod 'dzin ma// nam mkha' gang bas dkyil 'khor lha tshogs mchod// oṃ āḥbadz+ra dhu pe hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ dkyil 'khor kun tu rgyal ba mnyes byed pa// kun snang dmar ser rdo rje dril bu dang*// mar mes gang ba'i rin chen snod 'dzin ma// nam mkha' gang bas dkyil 'khor lha tshogs mchod// oṃ āḥbadz+ra di paṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ dkyil 'khor kun tu= gdung sel ljang gu= dri mchog byug pa'i= nam mkha' gang=

oṃ āḥbadz+ra gan+dhe= dkyil 'khor kun tu= zhal zas ser mo= bdud rtsis gang= nam mkha' gang= oṃ āḥbadz+ra naiwid+ya= dkyil 'khor kun tu= sgra snyan sna tshogs= pi wang gling bu rnga chen sogs 'dzin ma// nam mkha' gang bas dkyil 'khor lha tshogs mchod// oṃ āḥbadz+ra shap+ta hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ rgyas par spro na/ dzaṃ bu'i gser las rang byung lte ba zlum// rtsibs stong mu khyud mchog tu rnam 'phrul ba// mkha' la rab 'phags phyogs las rgyal byed pa'i// 'khor lo rin chen nam mkha' bkang ste 'bul// oṃ tsakra rat+na pra tīts+tsha hūm̐ swā hā/ thal dkar mche ba drug pa zla 'od can// chu zheng phun tshogs yud kyis mkha' lam nas// sa chen rgya mtsho'i ska rags can bskor ba'i// glang po rin chen nam mkha' bkang ste 'bul// oṃ hasti rat+na pra tīts+tsha hūm̐ swā hā/ spu kha rma bya'i mgrin 'dra yid 'ong zhing*// gser gyi rgyan ldan mgyogs pa yid lta bus// tho rangs sa rnams bskor te slar ldog pa'i// rta mchog rin chen nam mkha' bkang ste 'bul// oṃ a shwa rat+na pra tī ts+tsha hūm̐ swā hā/ kun tu sngo ba snang byed baiḍūr+ya// nyin mor byed pa 'od kyis rnam gnon cing*// bsam pa rdzogs byed legs sbyangs cha brgyad pa// nor bu rin chen= oṃ ma ṇi= 'chi med bu mo bzhin du gzugs mdzes shing*// reg bya mchog gis lus sems brtas byed pa// sgyu rtsal kun shes smra mkhas dri bzang ster// btsun mo rin chen= oṃ s+t+ri= phur bu'i blo ldan mdzangs shing yid gzhung ba// 'khor yug gter gyis 'dod dgur 'dzud byed cing*// des pa snyan pa'i tshig 'byin lha mig can/ khyim bdag rin chen= oṃ pu ru ṣa= sred med bu yi stobs ldan dpa' ba dang*// brtul phod yid la rgyus pa'i don rnams kun// mod la sgrub cing phas rgol med byed pa// blon po rin chen= khat+ga= 'od zer gyis sngo ral gri pags pa 'jam// dga' ba'i nags tshal gos ni yid rjes 'gro// mthu ldan mchil lahwam khang khyim gzhal du med// reg 'jam gzims cha nam mkha' bkang ste 'bul// oṃ u pa rat+na pra tīts+tsha hūm̐ swā hā/

zhes rgyal srid bdun dang*/ pad can dung ltar rab dkar zla bzhin ma// dpal gyi be'u thogs nas snyems pa yis// 'phags mchog thugs la dgyes pa'i rgyas btab pa'i// bkra shis dam pas kun tu shis gyur cig /oṃ shrī bat+s+ya pra tīts+tsha hūm̐ swā hā// 'jigs byed kun+da'i 'od can lus phra ma// gser gyi 'khor lo 'chang ba'i rnam 'gyur gyis// 'phags mchog thugs la dgyes pa'i rgyas btab pa'i// bkra shis dam pas kun tu shis gyur cig /oṃ su war+ṇa tsakra pra tīts+tsha hūm̐ swā hā/ 'od can mthon mthing bcu drug lang tsho ma// rin chen 'dab brgya bzung nas rol rtsed kyis// 'phags mchog= bkra shis= pad+ma kun+dza ra= rnam rgyal sngo skya 'dod pa'i dbyangs mkhas ma// rgyal mtshan bsgrengs shing ga ma kas bcings glus// 'phags mchog= bkra shis= kun+da dh+wa dza= mdangs ldan li khri'i rdul 'chang mig yangs ma// mu tig gdugs dkar bskor zhing zur mig mdas// 'phags mchog= bkra shis= si ta ta pa tre= /dkar sham mtshams sprin mdog can gzugs mdzes ma// gter gyi bum pas lag brel rtse 'jo yis// 'phags mchog= bkra shis= ni dhi gha ṭa= dri med margad mdangs ldan dpal ldan ma// g.yas su 'khyil ba'i dung bsnams 'jog sgeg gis// 'phags mchog= bkra shis= shaṅkha warta= yid gzhung rma bya'i mgrin 'dra dga' skyed ma// gser gyi nya 'dzin 'gying gzugs glog 'dra bas// 'phags mchog thugs la dgyes pa'i rgyas btab pa'i// bkra shis dam pas kun tu shis gyur cig /oṃ ka na ka mat+s+ya pra tīts+tsha hūm̐ swā hā/ zhes bkra shis kyi lha mo brgyad kyis mchod pa rnams phyi mchod/ mthon mthing 'od chags rdo rje pi wang ma// rgyud mang snyan pa'i skad kyis yid sgyur byed// rdo rje rig ma dga' ba'i rol pa 'dis// he ru ka khyod rdo rje yid dgyes mdzod// oṃ āḥbadz+ra wī ni hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ mchog gi gser mtshungs rdo rje gling bu ma// snyan 'gyur rin chen gling bu'i sgra dbyangs can// rdo rje rig ma dga' ba'i rol pa 'dis// he ru ka khyod rdo rje yid dgyes mdzod// oṃ āḥbadz+ra waṃ she hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/

bim pa ltar dmar rdo rje rdza rnga ma// skad snyan lha rdzas bzang po'i rdza rnga 'khrol// rdo rje rig ma= he ru ka khyod= mu rañdze= margad mdog mtshungs rdo rje rnga chen ma// rnga chen cher sgrogs nam mkha'i phyogs kun 'gengs// rdo rje rig ma= he ru ka khyod= mṛ taṃ ge= pad+ma rā ga'i mdangs ldan bzhad pa mo// 'dzum zhal dgyes pa'i bzhin gyis kun dga' skyed// rdo rje rig ma= he ru ka khyod= hā s+ya= mthon ka chen mo'i 'od 'dzin rab sgeg ma// rdo rje dril 'chang dkur brten snyems pa'i tshul// rdo rje rig ma= he ru ka khyod= lā s+ya= btso ma'i gser mdog rdo rje glu dbyangs ma// shes rab dbyangs snyan rna ba'i bcud len mkhan// rdo rje rig ma= he ru ka khyod= gī ti= rma bya'i spu ltar sngo ljang gar mkhan ma// mnyen lcug yan lag mchog gis bro gar sgyur// rdo rje rig ma= he ru ka khyod= nṛ t+ya= ston zla ltar dkar rdo rje me tog ma// lha rdzas me tog bye ba'i char 'bebs byed// rdo rje rig ma= he ru ka khyod= puṣ+pe= sngo skya dud sprin rdo rje bdug pa ma// mkha' khyab dri zhim bdug pa'i spos dri can// rdo rje rig ma= he ru ka khyod= dhu pe= gur gum gzhon nu'i lus can snang gsal ma// rin chen snang bas phyogs bcu'i mun sel byed// rdo rje rig ma= he ru ka khyod= di paṃ= 'char ka'i mdangs ltar dmar skya byug pa ma// legs sbyar dri mchog dge bas rnyog pa sel// rdo rje rig ma= he ru ka khyod= ghan+dhe= kha ba dung ltar rnam dkar gzugs can ma// rnam dag rin chen dngul dkar me long g.yob// rdo rje rig ma= he ru ka khyod= rū pa= le brgan rtsi ltar lus dmar ro ldan ma// bdud rtsi'i bcud ldan lha yi zhal zas 'dzin// rdo rje rig ma= he ru ka khyod= rā s+ya= dūr ba'i 'dab ltar ljang ser reg bya ma// reg pas bde ba mchog ster na bza' 'dzin// rdo rje rig ma=

he ru ka khyod= spar+she= kun+da ku muta rgyas 'dra chos dbyings ma// rgyal ba kun skyed skye gnas phyag rgya can// rdo rje rig ma dga' ba'i rol pa 'dis// he ru ka khyod rdo rje yid dgyes mdzod// oṃ āḥbadz+ra dharma dhā tu hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ zhes mchod pa nang*/ mchod do phud thams cad kyi mnga' bdag rigs thams cad kyi dbang phyug dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi gtso bo/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bo/ rtsa brgyud kyi rje btsun bla ma dam pa ma lus shing lus pa med pa rnams kyi zhal du pañtsa a mṛ ta pū dza khā hi/ oṃ shrī badz+ra he he ru ru kam̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ ḍā ki nī dzā la sam̐ ba raṃ swā hā/ oṃ hrīḥha ha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ pañtsa a mṛ ta pū dza khā hi/ oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī ye badz+ra war+ṇa nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ swā hā/ pañtsa a mṛ ta pū dza khā hi/ oṃ ḍā ki nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ lā ma ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ khaṇ+ḍa ro hi hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ rū pi ṇī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ pañtsa a mṛ ta pū dza khā hi/ oṃ ka ra ka ra khaṇ+ḍa ka pā la/ pra tsaṇ+ḍe hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ku ru ku ru ma hā kaṃ kā la/ tsaṇ+ḍa k+ṣe ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ban+dha ban+dha kaṃ kā la/ pra bhā wa ti ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ tra sa ya tra sa ya bi ga ṭa daṃ ṣ+ṭaṇa/ ma hā nā s+ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ pañtsa a mṛ pū dza khā hi/ oṃ k+ṣo bha ya k+ṣo bha ya sū ra wā+ai ti/ bī ra ma tī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ hrauṃ hrauṃ a mṛ ta bhe ba/ kharba rī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ hraḥhraḥ badz+ra pra bha wa/ laṅke shwa rī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ pheṃ pheṃ badz+ra de ha/ dru mats+tsha ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ pañtsa a mṛ ta pū dza khā hi/ oṃ phaṭ phaṭ aṅku rī ka/ ai rā ba tī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/

oṃ da ha da ha badz+ra dza ṭi la/ ma hā bhai ra wi hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ pa tsa pa tsa ma hā wi ra wā yu be ge hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ bhak+ṣa bhak+ṣa ba sa ru dhi rān+t+ra mā lā wa lam+bi ni badz+ra hūm̐ ka ra su ra bhak+ṣi nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ pañtsa a mṛ ta pū dza khā hi/ oṃ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa sap+ta pā tā la ga ta bhū dzaṅgaṃ sarbaṃ bā tardza ya tardza ya su bha dra sh+yā ma de wī hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ a kaḍ+ḍh+ya a kaḍ+ḍh+ya badz+ra pra bha/ su bha dre hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ hrīṃ hrī+iṃ ma hā bhai ra ba/ ha yā kar+ṇe hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ dzaṇauṃ dzaṇauṃ rū pāk+ṣa/ kha gā na ne hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ pañtsa a mṛ ta pū dza kha hi/ oṃ k+ṣ+māṃ k+ṣ+māṃ ma hā ba la/ tsakra be ge hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ hāṃ hāṃ rat+na badz+ra khaṇ+ḍa ro he hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ hīṃ hīṃ ha ya gṛ ba shauṇ+ḍi nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ ā ka sha gar+bha/ tsakra warmi nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ pañtsa= oṃ ki li ki li he ru ka /su bī rī hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ si li si li pad+ma nirti shwa ra/ ma hā ba le hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ hi li hi li bai ro tsa na/ tsakra warti nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ dhi li dhi li badz+ra satwa/ ma hā bīr+ya ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ pañtsa a mṛ ta pū dza khā hi/ oṃ ka kā s+ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ u lū kā s+ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ shwa nā ka s+ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ sū ka rā s+ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ pañtsa a mṛ ta pū dza khā hi/ oṃ ya ma da dhī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ya ma dū tī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ya ma daṃṣ+ṭi ṇi ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ya ma ma thā ni ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ pañtsa a mṛ ta pū dza khā hi/ bya ba'i rgyud/ spyod pa'i rgyud/ rnal 'byor rgyud/ rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud dang 'brel ba'i yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs ma lus shing lus pa med pa rnams kyi zhal du pañtsa a mṛ ta pū dza khā hi/

gnas gsum gyi dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro ma rnams dang*/ dur khrod chen po brgyad na gnas pa'i phyogs skyong dang zhing skyong gi mkha' 'gro ma ma lus shing lus pa med pa rnams kyi zhal du pañtsa= dpal ma hā kā la khrag 'thung gi rgyal po rnal 'byor gyi dgra lha/ dug gsum nad kyi sman pa/ gtsug lag khang dang dkyil 'khor gyi srung ma chen po bya rog gi ming can 'khor bka' sdod dang bcas pa la sogs pa dam pa chos skyong ba ma lus shing lus pa med pa rnams kyi zhal du pañtsar= gzhan yang yul phyogs 'di nyid na gnas pa la sogs pa'i lha ma srin sde brgyad/ 'gro ba rigs drug skye gnas rnam pa bzhis bsdus pa'i sems can thams cad kyi zhal du pañtsa a mṛ ta pū dza khā hi/ gsang mchod/ las kyi phyag rgya'i rab sbyor dang*// ye shes phyag rgya'i dmigs pa dang*// phyag rgya chen po gcig sbyor bas// 'phel ba'i mi 'gyur bde bas mchod/ de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa byas/ bstod pa ni/ hūm̐/ gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid// skad cig nyid la 'char ba gang*// bla ma rin chen lta bu'i sku// rdo rje can zhabs pad la 'dud// hūm̐/ zhe sdang tshul gyis zhe sdang 'joms mdzad cing*// chos dbyings rnam dag ye shes ngo bo nyid// rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma dang mnyam par sbyor// zhe sdang rdo rje khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod// hūm̐ mchog rdo rje las byung char sprin mdog /dga' ba rnam dag drag po'i zhal bzhir snang*// gar gyis nyams dgus gdug pa 'dul mdzad pa'i// hūm̐ mchog rdo rje khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod// rten 'brel bcu gnyis dag cing sa rnams rdzogs// bcu gnyis phyag gis mtshon cha sna tshogs 'dzin// yul dang yul can rnam rtog gcod mdzad pa'i// ngo mtshar mtshon cha bsnams la phyag 'tshal bstod// hūm̐ gi nga ros srid gsum skrag mdzad cing*// rngam pa'i rkan sgra phaṭ ces sgra sgrog pa// bdud dang bgegs sogs gdug pa ma lus 'dul// rnam rtog bdud bgegs 'joms la phyag 'tshal bstod// spros bral bde chen pad+ma rā ga'i mdog

/stong nyid 'od gsal dus gsum bde gshegs klong*// rnam rtog drwa ba ma lus 'joms mdzad pa'i// dus gsum rgyal ba'i yum la phyag 'tshal bstod// sa chu me rlung 'byung ba rnam par dag /dag pa'i zhal bzhi rigs kyi yum du snang*// dran pa nyer gzhag ye shes ngo bo nyid// mkha' 'gro ma sogs yum la phyag 'tshal bstod// sems kyi rnam dag sa bla'i srid pa sbyong*// zhe sdang rnam dag thugs kyi 'khor lo snang*// thod pa'i dum bu rab gtum ma la sogs// gnas dang nye gnas bzhugs la phyag 'tshal bstod// gsung gi nga ros sa yi srid pa bcom// 'dod chags rnam dag gsung gi 'khor lo snang*// myu gu can dang sa srungs ma la sogs// zhing dang nye zhing bzhugs la phyag 'tshal bstod// sku yi rol pas sa 'og srid pa bcom// gti mug rnam dag sku yi 'khor lo snang*// stobs po che dang 'khor lo'i shugs can sogs// 'du sogs gnas na bzhugs la phyag 'tshal bstod// yang dag las mtha' 'tsho ba rtsol dang bral// bde chen dag la mos dang gtso la phyogs// gdug pa'i tshogs rnams ma lus 'dul mdzad pa'i// sgo bzhi'i ma mor snang la phyag 'tshal bstod// brtson 'grus rnam dag yang dag spongs ba bzhi// gshin rje brtan ma la sogs ma mor snang*// phyogs gnyis 'dzin pa'i sku mdog ma mo'i mchog /rgyal ba'i yum du snang la phyag 'tshal bstod// bde gshegs brgyad ni rgyal ba'i sprul par bstan// bdag med 'khor lor dur khrod brgyad du snang*// byang chub rten du shing brgyad mngon par 'byong*// 'jig rten chos brgyad sreg la phyag 'tshal bstod/ zhes sam/ rkang pa brgyad pas bstod/ ji snyed su dag sogs yan lag bdun pa sngon du song nas lag mchod ni/ lag pa g.yon pa'i mthil du pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma lnga pa'i lte ba la oṃ baṃ phag mo dmar mo/ mdun nas g.yon bskor gyis haṃ yauṃ gshin rje ma sngon mo/

hriṃ moṃ rmongs byed ma dkar mo/ hriṃ hriṃ sreg byed ma ser mo/ hūm̐ hūm̐ skrag byed ma ljang gu/ phaṭ phaṭ tsaṇ+ḍi ka dud kha/ mthe bong la oṃ haḥrdo rje sems dpa' dkar po/ mdzub mo la na ma hi rnam par snang mdzad ser po/ gung mo la swa ha hu rin chen 'byung ldan dmar po/ srin lag la bau ṣaṭa he he ru ka nag po mthe'u chung la hūm̐ hūm̐ hoḥ'od dpag med mthing ga sen mo rnams kyi ngos la phaṭ haṃ rta mchog ljang ga oṃ baṃ/ haṃ yoṃ/ hriṃ moṃ/ hriṃ hriṃ/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ phaṭ phaṭ/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra puṣ+pe pra tits+tsha swā hā/ dhu pe= a lo ke= gan+dhe= nai wid+yā= shap+ta pra tits+tsha swā hā'i bar gyis mchod/ oṃ haḥ na ma hi/ swa ha hu/ bau ṣaṭa he/ hūm̐ hūm̐ ho/ phaṭ haṃ/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra puṣ+pe pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ sogs gong ltar dang*/ mdzes ma 'di dag phyag rgya che// mtha' yas bde ba sbyin pa mo// rigs lnga las byung 'di phul bas// rig pa'i brtul zhugs mthar phyin shog /ces rig ma dang*/ bza' btung*/ lcags kyu lnga dang bdud rtsi lnga// dngos grub kun gyi de nyid mchog /dkyil 'khor mchod pa bgyi bar 'tshal// rgyal ba'i ye shes lnga thob shog /sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta pū dza khā his mchod/ de nas/ sor mo'i lha rnams lag mthil du byon te yab yum rjes su chags pa mdzad pa lag pa'i rgyab tu me long dwangs pa'i gzugs bzhin du gsal bar snang*/ de nas/ yab yum de dag sa la sogs pa khams drug gi lha mor song chang gi khu bas byugs te/ lag pa de dpa' bo dang dpa' mo thams cad kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i 'khor lo gsum gyi ngo bo yul nyi shu rtsa bzhir gyur pa la/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te bī re shā ya ma hā kalpāg+ni san+ni bhā ya dza ṭā ma ku ṭot+ka ṭā ya dam̐ṣ+ṭā ka rā lo gra bhī ṣa ṇa mu khā ya sa ha sra bhu dza bhā su rā ya pa ra shu pā sho d+ya ta shū la kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dhā ri ṇe/ byā gh+ra dzi nām+bha ra dha rā ya/

ma hā dhū mabran+dha kā ra wa pu ṣā ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra puṣ+pe pra tits+tsha swā hā/ dhu pe/ a lo ke/ gan+dhe/ nai wi d+yā/ shap+ta pra tits+tsha swā hā 'i bar gyis mchod/ de nas phul ba'i me tog ste/ oṃ ka ra ka ra/ ku ru ku ru/ ban+dha ban+dha/ tra sa ya tra sa ya/ k+ṣo bha ya k+ṣo bha ya/ hrauṃ hrauṃ/ hraḥhraḥ phaiṃ phaiṃ/ phaṭ phaṭ/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ bhak+ṣa bhak+ṣa ba sa ru dhi ran+t+ra mā lā ba lam̐ bi ni/ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa sap+ta pā tā la ga ta bhu dzaṅgaṃ sar+b+baṃ bā tardza ya tardza ya/ ā kaḍ+ḍh+ya ā kaḍ+ḍh+ya/ hrīṃ hrīṃ/ dzaṇauṃ dzaṇauṃ/ k+ṣ+mām̐ k+ṣ+mām̐/ hām̐ hām̐/ hīṃ hīṃ/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ ki li ki li/ si li si li/ hi li hi li/ dhi li dhi li hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ ces pa'i mthar dkyil 'khor du dor/ yang blangs nas thal mo sbyar ba sngon du 'gro bas mgo bor bzhag go lha'i 'khor lo de las cha gcig 'phros pa bdag nyid la zhugs par gyur/ oṃ/ he ru ka dpal dam tshig rjes su skyong*// he ru ka dpal nyid kyis nye bar gnas// bdag la bstan dgyes chags shing dgyes par mdzod// dngos grub thams cad bdag la rab tu stsol// las kun la yang bdag sems nges legs mdzod// hūm̐ ha ha ha ha hoḥ bcom ldan khyod dang de bzhin gshegs kun gyis// rdo rje'i bar du bdag ni rnam grol mdzod// rdo rje can dngos dam tshig sems dpa' che āḥ

de nas phyogs kyi bdag po rnams la gtor ma sbyin pa'i phyir/ phyi rol du song nas/ shar du/ in+d+ra sa pa ri wā ra ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes bkug oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis gtor ma byin gyis brlabs nas/ in+d+ra sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ bha liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi gsum la sogs pas phul/ saṃ trip+ta sarba de wa tā sā da ka s+ye shin+taṃ ku ru sarba kar+yan+tu sid+dhi rbi ti ya tha su khaṃ su ṣe/ hūm̐/ dam can rgya mtsho khyed rnams kyis// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la// rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la// nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang*// dpal dang grags dang bskal pa bzang*// longs spyod rgya chen kun thob cing*// zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi// las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol// dam tshig can gyis bdag la srungs// dngos grub kun gyi stongs grogs mdzod// dus min 'chi dang nad rnams dang*// gdon dang bgegs rnams med par mdzod// rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan// bya byed ngan pa med par mdzod// 'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang*// 'bru rnams 'phel zhing phyugs 'phel ba// bde legs thams cad 'grub pa dang*// yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog /de bzhin pha rol tshogs 'joms shing*// dgra rnams thams cad pham par mdzod/ mer/ ag+ni sa pa ri= lhor/ ya ma sa pa ri= lho nub tu/ rak+ṣa sa pa ri= nub tu/ wa ru ṇa sa pa ri= nub byang du/ bā yu sa pa ri= byang du/ ku be ra sa pa ri= dbang ldan du/ ma hā bhū ta sa pa ri= steng du/ tsan+d+ra sūr+ya brah+ma ār+ya de wa ta sa pa ri= 'og tu/ bai tsi tri pri thi wī de wa ta sa pa ri= gzhan 'dra/ rgyas pa la/ puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru= sogs 'don pa bsgyur ba tsam mo/ nang du zhugs nas cang te'u 'khrol zhing*/ bkra shis gang zhig chos kyi dbyings nas legs byung ba'i// he ru ka dpal 'jigs byed rgyal po 'bar ba'i sku// shes rab phag mo'i pad+ma la ni rdo rjes rol mdzad pa// bden pa des kyang bde ba mchog la gnas pa'i bkra shis shog

/bkra shis gang zhig phyogs kyi pad+ma'i 'dab ma la// rigs kyi yum bzhi dpa' bo'i phyogs kyi zhal la gzigs// pad+ma'i mu khyud gri gug phreng bas rnam par brgyan// bden pa des kyang bde ba mchog la gnas pa'i bkra shis shog /bkra shis gang zhig mtshams kyi pad+ma'i 'dab ma la// byang chub sems dang tsan+dan dri chen gur gum chus// gang ba'i snod bzhi zhal gyi reg pas rnam par spyod// bden pa des kyang bde ba mchog la gnas pa'i bkra shis shog /bkra shis gang zhig nam mkha'i dbyings na legs spyod pa'i// 'khor lo sngon po rtsibs brgyad mu khyud rdo rje'i phreng*// gnas dang nye gnas la sogs dpa' bo rnal 'byor gnyis med rol// bden pa des kyang= bkra shis gang zhig sa steng dag na legs spyod pa'i// 'khor lo dmar po rtsibs brgyad mu khyud pad+ma'i phreng*// zhing dang nye zhing la sogs dpa' bo rnal 'byor gnyis med rol// bden pa des kyang= bkra shis gang zhig ngan 'gro'i gnas na legs spyod pa'i// 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad mu khyud 'khor lo'i phreng*// 'du dang nye 'du la sogs dpa' bo rnal 'byor gnyis med rol// bden pa des kyang= bkra shis gang zhig dkyil 'khor sgo bzhi mtshams rnams su/ khwa gdong la sogs lha mo yid 'ong gzugs gnyis ldan// thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don mdzad gdug pa kun 'dul ba'i// bden pa des kyang= bkra shis gang zhig dran pa nye bar gzhag pa bzhi rnams dang*// yang dag spong ba rdzu 'phrul dbang po stobs la sogs// byang chub phyogs chos sum cu rtsa bdun yongs rdzogs pa'i// bden pa des kyang= bkra shis gang zhig rin chen pha gus mdzes pa'i gzhal yas khang*// 'dod pa lnga yi longs spyod mchog ni rab tu bkod pa dang*// mu tig drwa ba rin chen nyi zla gser gyi dril bu dpyangs// bden pa des kyang= bkra shis gang zhig rta babs chos kyi 'khor lo gdugs kyis phub// mdzes pa'i ri dwags ba dan bcu drug legs 'phyar ba'i// rlung gis bskyod pa'i dril bu dag las chos kyi sgra chen sgrog

/bden pa des kyang= bkra shis gang zhig dur khrod ra ba brgyad kyis yongs bskor zhing*// byang chub shing mchog brgyad ni rab tu byung ba las// sha za'i gdong can brgyad po dag ni legs gnas pa'i// bden pa des kyang= bkra shis gang zhig ye shes me chen brgyad ni 'bar bar gyur pa dang*// byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin sprin chen brgyad ni 'dus par gyur pa la// dga' bo la sogs klu chen sde bcas brgyad po dag ni legs gnas pa'i// bden pa des kyang= bkra shis gang zhig thugs rje'i rang bzhin chu chen brgyad ni 'bab par gyur pa dang*// brgya byin la sogs phyogs skyong brgyad po rnams kyis rab tu bskor gyur cing*// rnal 'byor pa dang rnal 'byor ma ni dur khrod rnams kyi nang na mdzes// bden pa des kyang bde ba mchog la gnas pa'i bkra shis shog /ces pa'i glu len cing dkyil 'khor gyi sa gzhi de la lan gsum du bskor ro// de nas bum bskyed ni/ oṃ khaṇ+ḍa ro hi hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhāḥsarba dhār+m+mā swa bhā ba shud+dho ྅haṃ/ bum pa mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūm̐ las bum pa dang thod pa rin po che sna tshogs kyis khang pa brtsegs pa gru bzhi sgo bzhi rgyan rta babs la sogs pa'i mtshan nyid tshang ba dur khrod brgyad kyis bskor ba/ nang phyogs mdog can gyi dbus su bde chen gyi 'khor lo sdong bu dang bcas gyen du 'phags pa'i rin po che'i pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa phyogs dmar mtshams ser nag ljang mthing ka /mu khyud gri gug gi phreng ba can gyi lte bar nyi gdan la 'jigs byed nag po lag pa bzhi pa'i ro kha bub pa dang*/ dus mtshan ma gson mo gan rkyal bsgyel ba pad+ma'i 'og gi nam mkhar mkha' spyod kyi yul brgyad kyi rang bzhin/ thugs kyi 'khor lo sngon po rdo rje'i mu khyud can/ sa gzhi'i thad du sa spyod kyi yul brgyad kyi rang bzhin gsung gi 'khor lo dmar po pad+ma'i mu khyud can/

sa 'og tu sa 'og spyod kyi yul brgyad kyi rang bzhin sku'i 'khor lo dkar po 'khor lo'i mu khyud can/ thams cad rtsibs brgyad pa lha gnas thams cad du nyi ma dang ro gdan/ lte ba'i gdan gyi steng du/ bcom ldan 'das dpal 'khor lo sdom pa/ in dra nī la dang mtshungs pa'i sku mdog sngon po zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis pa zhabs g.yas brkyang bas dus mtshan ma dmar mo'i nu ma mnan pa/ g.yon cung zad bskum pas 'jigs byed sngon po'i dpral ba mnan pa/ rtsa zhal sngon po/ g.yon zhal ljang gu/ rgyab zhal dmar po/ g.yas zhal ser po/ zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ nor bu dang sna tshogs rdo rje dang zla ba phyed pas mtshan pa'i ral pa'i thor tshugs can// dbu re re la mi mgo skam po lnga lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal byas pa/ 'khor lo dang*/ rna cha dang*/ mgul rgyan dang*/ gdu bu dang*/ ska rags dang*/ thal chen te phyag rgya drug gis brgyan pa/ zhal mche ba gtsigs shing 'jigs par byed pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can// gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan pa ste/ sku dpa' ba dang sgeg pa dang*/ 'jigs su rung ba dang*/ gsung rgod pa dang*// gshe ba dang*/ rngam pa dang*/ thugs snying rje ba dang*/ zhi ba dang*/ ngo mtshar ba'o// phyag bcu gnyis kyis spras pa'i dang po gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ de'i 'og ma gnyis kyis glang po che'i pags pa rlon pa gdeng nas 'dzin pa/ g.yas kyi gsum pa na ḍā ma ru/ bzhi pa na dgra s+t+wa/ lnga pa na gri gug /drug pa na mdung rtse gsum pa/ g.yon gyi gsum pa na kha ṭ+wām̐ ga /bzhi pa na thod pa khrag gis gang ba/ lnga pa na rdo rje'i zhags pa/ drug pa na tshangs pa'i mgo bo gdong bzhi pa bsnams pa/ de'i pang na yum rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/ in+t+ras gang ba'i thod pa 'dzin pa'i phyag g.yon pas yab la 'khyud pa/

g.yas rdo rje dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub steng gi nam mkha' la 'phyar ba/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ thod skam lnga cu'i do shal byas pa gcer bu skra grol zhing phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ byin pa gnyis kyis bcom ldan 'das kyi brla gnyis la 'khyud pa/ gnyis ka'ang ye shes gyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs par gyur// shar gyi 'dab ma la mkha' 'gro ma sku mdog nag mo/ byang du lā ma ljang gu/ nub dang las bum du dum skyes ma dmar mo/ lhor gzugs can ma ser mo/ mtshams kyi 'dab ma bzhi la byang chub sems kyis gang ba'i bum pa bzhi'i steng du bdud rtsi lngas gang ba'i thod pa bzhi'o// lha mo de thams cad zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma g.yas gnyis gri gug dang ḍā ma ru/ g.yon gnyis thod pa dang kha ṭ+wām̐ ga 'dzin pa skra grol zhing phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang bas pad nyi dang ro'i gdan la bzhugs pa/ thod pa dang rdo rje phreng bas dbu la brgyan pa/ mi mgo lnga cu'i do shal can sku drag mo'i gzugs can du gyur/ thugs kyi 'khor lo'i rtsibs kyi phyogs g.yon bskor du/ dpa' bo thod pa'i dum bu dang dpa' mo rab gtum ma/ keng rus chen po dang gtum pa'i mig can ma/ keng rus dang 'od ldan ma/ mche ba rnam par gtsigs pa dang sna chen ma/ me nas g.yas bskor gyis lha dgra dang dpa' bo'i blo gros ma/ 'od dpag med dang mi'u thung ma/ rdo rje'i 'od dang laṅka'i dbang phyug ma/ rdo rje'i lus dang shing grib ma rnams sngon po/ rim pa de nyid kyis gsung gi 'khor lo'i phyogs la/ myu gu can dang sa srungs ma/ rdo rje'i ral pa can dang 'jigs byed chen mo/ dpa' bo chen po dang rlung gi shugs can ma/ rdo rje hūm̐ mdzad dang chang 'thung ma/ mtshams su rab tu bzang po dang sngo bsangs mo/ rdo rje bzang po dang shin du bzang mo// 'jigs byed dang rta rna ma/ mig mi bzang dang bya gdong ma thams cad dmar po/

sku'i 'khor lo'i phyogs la stobs po che dang 'khor lo'i shugs can ma/ rin chen rdo rje dang dum skyes ma/ rta mgrin dang chang tshong ma/ nam mkha'i snying po dang 'khor lo'i go cha ma/ mtshams la he ru ka dang bzhin bzang mo/ pad+ma gar dbang dang stobs chen ma/ rnam par snang mdzad dang 'khor lo sgyur ma/ rdo rje sems dpa' dang brtson 'grus chen mo thams cad dkar po/ dpa' bo thams cad zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa thugs kyi g.yas rdo rje dang*/ gsung gi pad+ma sku'i 'khor lo/ g.yon de so sos yu ba byas pa'i dril bu bzung ste dpa' mo la 'khyud pa/ lhag ma gnyis ḍā ma ru dang khaṭ+wām̐ ga 'dzin pa/ spyan gsum pa ral pa'i thor tshugs can/ mi mgo skam po'i dbu rgyan dang*// rlon pa'i do shal can phyag rgya drug gis brgyan te skyil krung phyed pa'i gar gyis bzhugs pa'i pang na dpa' mo rnams zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin cing skra grol ba/ phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa'o// shar sgor khwa gdong ma nag mo/ byang sgor 'ug gdong ma ljang gu /nub sgor khyi gdong ma dmar mo/ lho sgor phag gdong ma ser mo/ shar lhor gshin rje brtan ma g.yas sngo g.yon ser ba/ lho nub tu gshin rje pho nya mo g.yas ser g.yon dmar ba/ nub byang du gshin rje mche ba can ma g.yas dmar g.yon ljang ba/ byang shar du gshin rje 'joms ma g.yas ljang g.yon sngo ba/ lha mo de thams cad zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma g.yas gnyis gri gug dang ḍā ma ru/ g.yon gnyis thod pa dang khaṭ+wām̐ ga 'dzin pa/ gcer bu skra grol zhing phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa zhabs g.yas brkyang bas pad nyi dang ro'i gdan la bzhugs pa/ thod pa dang rdo rje phreng bas dbu la brgyan pa/ mi mgo lnga cu'i do shal can sku drag mo'i gzugs can du gyur/ gtso bo dang lha mo rnams byang chub kyi phyogs so bdun/ so sen la sogs pa'i khams rnams dpa' bo nyer bzhir rnam par dag pa'o/

oṃ haḥ gtso bo'i snying gar rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po dkar ser dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas gsum rdo rje ḍā ma ru tshangs mgo /g.yon gsum dril bu thod pa khaṭ+wām̐ ga bsnams pa/ na ma hi dpral bar rnam par snang mdzad ser po/ swa ha hu/ spyi bor rin chen 'byung gnas dmar po/ bau ṣaṭa he phrag pa gnyis la he ru ka nag po/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hoḥ spyan gsum la 'od dpag med mthing ga /phaṭ haṃ/ yan lag thams cad la don yod grub pa ljang gu/ de thams cad zhal gcig phyag bzhi'i dang po gnyis/ 'khor lo/ rin po che/ rdo rje/ pad+ma/ sna tshogs rdo rje dang de'i dril bu thugs kar bsnol ba/ lhag ma gnyis ḍā ma ru dang thod pa/ dpa' bo'i chas kyis brgyan te g.yas brkyang gis bzhugs pa/ oṃ haḥ na ma hi/ swa ha hu/ bauṣaṭa he/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hoḥ phaṭ haṃ/ zhes brjod pas byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ baṃ/ yum gyi lte bar phag mo dmar mo dmar ljang ser ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas gsum gri gug kha ṭ+wām̐ ga /lcags kyu/ g.yon gsum thod pa/ tshangs mgo zhags pa bsnams pa/ haṃ yoṃ snying gar gshin rje ma sngon mo/ hriṃ moṃ mgrin par rmongs byed ma dkar mo/ hriṃ hriṃ mtshog mar skyod byed ma ser mo/ hūm̐ hūm̐ spyi gtsug tu skrag byed ma ljang gu /phaṭ phaṭ yan lag thams cad la tsaṇ+ḍī ka dud kha/ de thams cad zhal gcig phyag bzhi'i dang po gnyis gri gug dang thod pa/ lhag ma gnyis kha ṭ+wām̐ ga dang ḍā ma ru dpa' mo'i chas gyis brgyan te g.yon brkyang gis bzhugs pa/ oṃ baṃ/ haṃ yoṃ/ hriṃ moṃ/ hriṃ hriṃ/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ phaṭ phaṭ kyis byin gyis brlab bo/ 'bar ba'i phyag rgya mig g.yon gyi steng du bskor lta stangs der gtad rkang pa g.yas pas g.yon pa'i bol mnan/ snying kha'i 'od zer gyis lcags kyus bsgoms pa ji lta ba'i ye shes kyi 'khor lo dbang lha rigs lnga dang bcas pa pheṃ/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ dam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par gyur/

de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bum bskyed kyi lha la dbang bskur du gsol/ de dag gis spros pa'i gzugs ma rnams kyis bdud rtsi lngas gang ba'i bum pa 'dzin pas/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// lha rnams kun gyis khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yis// de bzhin dag pa'i sku khrus gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐/ zhes pas dbang bskur bas/ chu de las byung ba'i rigs kyi bdag po gtso bo la mi bskyod pa// yum la rnam snang*/ bde chen gyi lha mor rin 'byung*/ thugs la mi bskyod pa/ gsung la snang mtha'/ sku la snang mdzad/ dam tshig la don grub/ sprul sku'i cha lugs can gyis dbu brgyan par bya'o/ spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐ las 'od zer spros/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs bskul bas sems can gyi dug gsum sbyang bar mdzad de 'od zer dang lhan cig yi ge gsum la zhugs pas sku rdo rje gsung rdo rje thugs rdo rje rig ma dang bcas par gyur pa'i 'od kyis lus thams cad khyab par gyur bar/ yid las byung ba'i lha mo rnams kyis/ oṃ shrī he ru ka pra war sat+ka ra ma hā ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha hūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ shrī he ru ka ma hā pa d+yaṃ ma ma tat+taṃ gṛh+ṇa sid+dhi m+me pra yats+tsha hūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ shrī he ru ka sa tut+ka pra tīts+tsha hūm̐ swā hā

zhes mchod pa chu gsum sngon du 'gro bas/ lha yi me tog shin tu 'bar// lha yi dri yis nye bar byugs// me tog bzang po 'di bzhes la// gnas 'di nyid du bzhugs su gsol// oṃ āḥbadz+ra puṣ+pe pra tits+tsha swā hā/ tsan+dan gur gum sbyar ba yi// dri mchog bdug spos dam pa 'di// dbang po'i sgo rnams tshim pa'i mchog /byin gyis rlobs la bzhes su gsol/ dhu pe= mar me 'od bzang 'bar ba 'di// ngan 'gro'i mun pa 'joms byed cing*// lha yi mig 'byed dam pa 'di// bdag la dgongs te= dī paṃ= sna tshogs lha yi dri dang ldan// sna tshogs ga pur gyis ni brgyan// sna tshogs hūm̐ las yang dag byung*// dri mchog 'di dag= gan+dhe= kha dog dri dang ro ldan pa// bza' ba'i bye brag sna tshogs pa// zhal zas thams cad phun sum tshogs// 'gro ba'i don du= nai wid+yā= pa ṭa ha dang cang te'u dang*// rnga dang dung sogs sgra dbyangs can// yid 'phrog sil snyan sna tshogs pa// he ru ka dpal tshogs la 'bul// oṃ āḥbadz+ra shap+ta pra tīts+tsha hūm̐ swā hā/ zhing 'dir rgyal srid sna bdun gyis// mkhas pa dag gis yongs bkang ste// dngos grub 'dod pa 'jo ba'i phyir// nyin re shes rab can gyis mchod// oṃ āḥrat+na sap+ta hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ bde mchog sgyu ma'i longs spyod rdzogs pa'i 'phrul// pi wang gling bu rnga zlum rdza rnga can// brgyad gnyis lang tsho dpal 'bras nu 'bur ma// bcu drug dga' ba'i cha shas yongs rdzogs ma// nya rgyas zla ba dag pa'i bzhin ras ma// tshim zhing gsal ba bdud rtsi'i 'od ldan ma// rdo rje rig ma lha mos deng mchod na// mchog tu bde ba dam pa'i mchog sbyin mdzod// oṃ āḥbadz+ra wī ni hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ waṃ she= mu rañdze= mṛ taṃ ge= bde mchog= rgod dang dregs ldan glu dbyangs bro gar mkhan// zur mig 'phen mkhas 'dod pa'i mda' 'phen ma// 'chi med na chung sgyu ma'i 'jo sgeg ma// yid 'phrog dpa' mo rdo rje'i glu dbyangs ma// 'gying gzugs glog 'dra gar dgu'i rtsed 'jo ma// rdo rje rig ma lha mos deng mchod na// mchog tu bde ba dam pa'i mchog sbyin mdzod// hā s+ya=

lā s+ya= gī ti= nṛt+ya= bde mchog= me tog bdug pa snang gsal dri chab 'dzin// rnam rgyal pad dkar gzhon nu'i zhal mdzes ma// dri zhim ma li gsar pa'i dri ldan ma// mtshar sdug 'od kyis phyogs cha rnam 'gengs ma// ga pur tsan+dan shing ltar gdung sel ma// rdo rje rig ma lha mos deng mchod na// mchog tu bde ba dam pa'i mchog sbyin mdzod// puṣ+pe= dhu pe= dī paṃ= gan+dhe= bde mchog= gzugs bcud reg bya chos kyi lha mo ni// mdzes sdug dpe byad bzang po'i dpal ldan ma// ma mchu bdud rtsi gtsang ma'i ro ldan ma// reg byas dbang po kun nas tshim byed ma// bsam yas lhan cig skyes dga'i 'byung gnas ma// rdo rje rig ma lha mos deng mchod na// mchog tu bde ba dam pa'i mchog sbyin mdzod// rū pa= rā s+ya= spar+she= oṃ āḥbadz+ra dharma dhā tu hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ mchod do byin rlabs kyi rtsa ba bka' brgyud bla ma rnams kyi zhal du pañtsa a mṛ ta pū dza khā hi/ dngos grub kyi rtsa ba yi dam lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal du= phrin las kyi rtsa ba mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma rnams kyi zhal du pañtsa a mṛ ta pū dza khā hi/ bcom ldan mgon po dpa' bo'i dbang phyug ni// bskal pa'i me chen lta bur rab tu 'bar// ral pa'i cod pan dbu yi rgyan du bcings// mche ba rab gtsigs drag shul rngam pa'i zhal// sku la phyag stong gzi brjid ldan pa po// dgra s+t+wa zhags pa kha ṭ+wām̐ mdung bsnams shing*// rab 'jigs stag gi pags pa gos su gyon// sku chen dud kha bgegs mthar mdzad la 'dud// bcom ldan 'das ma rdo rje phag mo 'phags ma ni// 'jig rten gsum sogs phyogs gzhan rgol bas mi thub cing*// 'byung po'i 'jigs pa ma lus rdo rje chen mos 'joms// rdo rje gdan bzhugs tshangs sogs dbang bsgyur las rgyal zhing*// rdo rje phag mo khro mo'i gzugs can drag snyems ma// rmug byed rengs byed myos byed las ni rnam rgyal zhing*// bdud kyi 'jigs pa pham zhing skem par mdzad pa mo// rnal 'byor chen mo 'dod pa'i dbang phyug ma la 'dud// dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ni// mkha' 'gro ma yi 'khor lo sgyur// ye shes lnga dang sku gsum nyid// 'gro ba skyob la phyag 'tshal lo// ji snyed rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// kun tu rtog pa'i 'ching gcod cing*// 'jig rten bya ba rab 'jug ma// de snyed rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod// sngags gzungs thag la 'khril te rnam rgyal chen po'i lha rnams kyi thugs kar thim par gyur/

oṃ shrī badz+ra he he ru ru kam̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ ḍā ki nī dzā la sam̐ ba ram̐ swā hā/ oṃ hrīḥha ha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī ye badz+ra war+ṇa nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra be ro tsa nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ swā hā/ oṃ ḍā ki nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ lā ma ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ khaṇ+ḍa ro hi hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ rū pi ṇī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ka ra ka ra khaṇ+ḍa ka pā la/ pra tsaṇ+ḍe hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ku ru ku ru ma hā kaṃ kā la/ tsaṇ+ḍa k+ṣe ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ban+dha ban+dha kaṃ kā la/ pra bhā wa ti ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ trā sa ya trā sa ya bi ga ṭa daṃ ṣ+ṭa ṇa/ ma hā nā s+ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ k+ṣo bha ya k+ṣo ya sū ra wā+ai ti/ bī ra ma tī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ hrauṃ hrauṃ a mṛ ta bha ba/ kharba ri ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ hraḥhraḥbadz+ra pra bha wa/ laṅke shā ri ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ pheṃ pheṃ badz+ra de ha/ dru mats+tsha ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ phaṭ phaṭ aṅku rī ka /ai rā ba tī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ da ha da ha badz+ra dza ṭi la/ ma hā bhai ra wi hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ pa tsa pa tsa ma hā wi ra/ wā yu be ge hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ bhak+ṣa bhak+ṣa ba sa ru dhi rān+t+ra mā lā wa lam+bi ni badz+ra hūm̐ ka ra/ su ra bhak+ṣi nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa sap+ta pā tā la ga ta bhu dzaṅgaṃ sarbaṃ bā tardza ya tardza ya su bha dra sh+yā ma de wī hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ a kaḍ+ḍh+ya a kaḍ+ḍh+ya badz+ra pra bha/ su bha dre hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ hrīṃ hrīṃ ma hā bhai ra ba/ ha yā kar+ṇe hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ dzaṇauṃ dzaṇauṃbi rū pāk+ṣa/ kha gā na ne hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ k+ṣ+māṃ k+ṣ+māṃ ma hā ba la/ tsakra be ge hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ hāṃ hāṃ rat+na badz+ra khaṇ+ḍa ro he hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ hīṃ hīṃ ha ya gṛ ba/ shaun+ḍi nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/

oṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ ā ka sha gar+bha/ tsakra warmi nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ki li ki li he ru ka /su bī rī hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ si li si li pad+ma nirti shwa ra/ ma hā ba le hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ hi li hi li bai ro tsa na tsakra war+t+ti nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ dhi dhi li badz+ra satwa/ ma hā bīr+ya ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ka kā s+ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ u lū kā s+ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ shwa nā ka s+ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ sū ka rā s+ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ya ma da dhī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ya ma dū ti ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ya ma daṃ ṣ+ṭi ṇi ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ya ma ma thā ni ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ lan gsum/ de bum par blugs pas de'i rkyen gyis lha thams cad bdud rtsi'i ngo bor ltem gyis zhu bar gyur/ las bum ni/ oṃ khaṇ+ḍa ro hi hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ lan bdun/ khaṇ+ḍa ro hi 'od du zhu nas bum pa'i chur gyur/ rdo rje'i tshig rkang 'dir gsung*/ bdag 'jug bya ba ni/ gzhan la ji tsam bskur ba de tsam blang bar gsungs/ dam tshig gso ba'i dbang la thams cad len pa phyag bzhes so/ de ltar 'jug pa dang dngos gnyis las/ 'jug pa la/ phyi nang gsang 'jug gsum/ phyir 'jug ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyi ni// lha rnams kun gyis khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yis// de bzhin dag pa'i sku khrus gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka te sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐/ zhes pas khrus bya bgegs la gtor ma/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṇaṃ a d+ya nu t+pan+na twa ta oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭ swā hā sa byin/ nga ni dpal ldan snying rje'i stobs// srung ba'i 'khor lo rab sbyor bas// lus srul la sogs gang ci yang*// bgegs kyi tshogs rnams gzhan du dengs// ci ste ngas bsgo su zhig 'da'// rdo rje'i bdag po sku yis ni// lus srul la sogs 'gas bya ste// 'dir ni brlag 'gyur gzhan du min// sa'i phyogs 'dir rdo rje 'dzin pa bdag gis dpal he ru ka mngon par 'byung ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi rgyal por 'jug cing dbang zhu ba la bar du gcod pa/

gang su yang rung ba sa phyogs 'di na gnas pa'i lha dang*/ klu dang lha ma yin dang*// gnod sbyin dang srin po dang*/ yi dwags dang*/ sha za dang*/ brjed byed dang*/ 'byung po dang*/ nam mkha' lding dang*/ mi'am ci dang*/ rig pa 'dzin pa la sogs pa rgan po dang rgan mo dang g.yog dang 'khor du bcas pa rnams 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du dengs shig /'di ltar rdo rje 'dzin pa'i bka' thos nas myur ba nyid du phyir dengs shig /gang dag mi 'gro ba de dag phyag na rdo rje rab tu 'bar ba hūm̐ kā ra shin tu khros pa ye shes kyi rdo rje chen po kun nas rab tu 'bar bas mgo bo tshal pa brgyar 'gas par 'gyur ta re/ oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ gṛh+ṇa pa ya gṛh+ṇa pa ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ā na ya hoḥbha ga wān bid+yā rā dza hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ kyis bgegs bskrad/ oṃ me dī ni badz+ri bha wa badz+ra ban+dha hūṃbaṃ hūm̐/ rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ oṃ badz+ra prā kā ra hūm̐ paṃ hūm̐/ rdo rje'i ra ba/ oṃ badz+ra pañdzā ra hūm̐ yaṃ hūm̐/ rdo rje'i gur/ oṃ badz+ra bi tā na hūm̐ khaṃ hūm̐/ rdo rje'i bla re/ oṃ badz+ra shaḥr dzā la traṃ saṃ traṃ/ rdo rje'i mda' yi drwa ba/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la a na lārka hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ phyi rol tu rdo rje'i me'i ra ba rab tu 'bar bas bskor bar gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis gdong g.yogs/ aḥkhaṃ bī ra hūm̐ gis me tog gi phreng ba gtad/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku// slob dpon la ni skyabs su mchi// dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma 'khor lo// rnal 'byor rnams la bdag phyag 'tshal// thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu// mgon pos bdag ni gzhug par mdzod/ kyai/ khyod su zhig ces dri bdag ni skal bzang ngo*/ zhes lan gdab/ nang 'jug de nas slob dpon gyis/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas// he ru ka dpal grong khyer mchog /snying po'i dkyil 'khor 'di ru ni// bdag nyid rab tu gzhug par bgyi/

/shar sgo nas zhugs te lha rnams la dmigs nas/ oṃ na maḥte hūm̐/ na maḥmi hūm̐/ na mo na maḥhūm̐/ shar sgor/ oṃ sarba bī ra yo gi nī pū dzo paṣ+ṭhā nā ya/ āt+mā nāṃ nir+yā ta yā mi sarba ta thā ga ta ḍā ki nī a dhi tiṣ+ṭha swa māṃ/ mkha' 'gro mas rdo rje gcig gnang ba snying gar thim/ de nas byang gi sgo ru phyin/ oṃ sarba bī ra yo gi nī pū dza a bhi ṣe kā ya āt+ma nāṃ nir+yā ta yā mi/ sarba ta thā ga ta lā ma abhi ṣiñtsa tu maṃ/ lā mas rdo rje rgya gram sbyin pa dpral bar thim/ nub sgor/ oṃ sar+b+ba bī ra yo gi nī pū tsa pra war+t+tā nā ya at+ma nāṃ nir+yā ta yā mi/ sarba ta thā ga ta khaṇ+ḍa ro hi nir+yā pra war+t+ta yā maṃ/ khaṇ+ḍa ro his pad+ma gcig sbyin pa mgrin par thim/ de nas lho sgor song ste/ oṃ sarba bī ra yo gi ni pū dza karma ṇe at+mā nāṃ nir+yā ta yā mi/ sarba ta thā ga ta rū pi ni āt+ma karma ku ru tu māṃ/ gzugs can mas rin po che sbyin pa spyi bor thim/ shar khyams su bzhag oṃ sarba yo ga tsit+ta ut+pa da yā mi/ lan gsum brjod/ su ra ste sa ma ya staṃ hoḥsiḍ+ḍh+ya badz+ra ya thā su khaṃ/ zhes rdo rje snying khar gtugs pas byin gyis brlabs/ 'di tsam dbang mi zhu bar 'jug pa tsam don du gnyer ba la yang bya ste/ sdom 'byung las/ skye ba sngon bsags sdig pa rnams// dkyil 'khor mthong bas byang bar 'gyur// zhes pa'i dgos pas so// gsang ba'i 'jug pa/ rgyud der/ sku gsung thugs kyi sdom pa'ang byin/ rigs gsum gyi dam tshig dang*/ 'ang gis rin po che dang*/ las rigs kyang ster bar bshad pas/ slob mas 'jug yon dang bcas te/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo tha mi dad pa'i drung du dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa zhu ba'i yon du/ oṃ badz+ra bhū mi āḥhūm̐/ dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi// oṃ badz+ra re ṣe āḥhūm̐/ phyi lcags ri'i khor yug gis bskor ba'i dbus su/

ri'i rgyal po ri rab/ shar lus 'phags po// lho dzam bu'i gling*/ nub ba lang spyod/ byang sgra mi snyan/ shar du lus dang lus 'phags lhor rnga yab dang rnga yab gzhan/ nub tu g.yo ldan dang lam mchog 'gro/ byang du sgra mi snyan dang sgra mi snyan gyi zla/ 'khor lo rin po che/ nor bu rin po che/ btsun mo rin po che// blon po rin po che/ glang po rin po che/ rta mchog rin po che/ dmag dpon rin po che/ gter chen po'i bum pa/ nyi ma/ zla ba/ rin po che'i gdugs/ phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyal mtshan/ dbus su lha dang mi'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa ma tshang ba med pa/ tshang zhing yid du 'ong ba dang bcas pa 'di nyid/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo tha mi dad pa'i drung du dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa zhu ba'i yon du 'bul bar bgyi'o// thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol// bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol// gu ru i daṃ maṇ+ḍa la kaṃ nir+ya tā ya mi/ mi ldog 'khor lo'i dbang bskur mchog /stsal nas mgon pos bdag la ni// 'khor lo lha yi de nyid dang*// slob dpon gyi ni las rnams dang*// sangs rgyas mchog gi dam tshig ni// sdom pa gsang ba bla na med// rtag tu sems can kun don phyir// slob dpon du 'gyur bdag la gsungs/ /lan gsum/ slob dpon gyis/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su song*// 'di ni sangs rgyas rigs dag pa'i// dam tshig brtan por gyur pa'o// rdo rje dril bu'i phyag rgya yang*// blo chen gyis ni gzung bar bya// byang chub sems gang deng rdo rje// shes rab dril bu zhes bshad do// slob dpon dag kyang bzung bar bya// bla ma sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam// 'di ni rdo rje'i rigs dag pa'i// sdom pa dam tshig yin par gsung*// rin chen rigs mchog chen po la// nyin dang mtshan mo lan gsum du// zang zing mi 'jigs chos dang byams// sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin// phyi dang gsang ba theg pa gsum// dam pa'i chos ni gzung bar bya// 'di ni pad+ma'i rigs dag pa'i// dam tshig sdom pa yin par gsungs// las kyi rigs mchog chen po la// sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni// yang dag nyid du gzung bar bya// mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bya/

/zhes bsgrag /slob mas/ slob dpon 'dir ni bdag la gson// gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa// de dag thams cad bdag gis bgyi// ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams// byang chub tu ni nges mdzad pa// de bzhin bla med byang chub sems// dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi// sdom pa yi ni tshul khrims dang*// dge ba'i chos rnams sdud pa dang*// sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum// bdag gis brtan por gzung bar bgyi// sangs rgyas rnal 'byor sdom pa la// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum// deng nas brtsams te mchog tu gzung*// rdo rje rigs mchog chen po la// rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya yang*// yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi// slob dpon dag kyang gzung bar bgyi// rin chen rigs mchog chen po yi// dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la// nyin re bzhin du dus drug tu// sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin// byang chub chen po las byung ba'i// pad+ma'i rigs chen dag pa la// phyi dang gsang ba theg pa gsum// dam pa'i chos ni ma lus gzung*// las kyi rigs mchog chen po la// sdom pa thams cad ldan pa ni// yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi// mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi// byang chub sems ni bla med pa// dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi// sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir// bdag gis sdom pa ma lus bzung*// ma bsgral ba rnams bdag gis bsgral// ma grol ba rnams bdag gis dgrol// dbugs ma phyin pa dbugs dbyung zhing*// sems can mya ngan 'das la 'god/ /ces lan gsum gyis khas blangs/ rdo rje spyi bor bzhag deng khyod dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi nang du zhugs kyis// ngas khyod la dpal he ru ka'i ye shes bskyed par bya yis ye shes gang gis khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang*// dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi dngos grub thob par 'gyur na dngos grub gzhan lta ci smos/

khyod kyis dkyil 'khor 'di ma mthong ba'i mdun du smra bar mi bya ste/ khyod dam tshig nyams par 'gyur ta re/ rdo rje snying gar bzhag ste/ he ru ka dpal deng khyod kyi// snying la yang dag zhugs par mdzad// gal te tshul 'di smras na ni// de ma thag tu dral te gshegs/ mna' chu blud pa/ bdud rtsi ril bu chang dang sbyar ba oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis byin gyis brlabs pa/ 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu// dam tshig 'das na sreg par byed// dam tshig bsrungs na dngos grub ni// rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'dis 'grub// oṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛ tot+ta ka hūm̐/ de nas slob dpon gyis dam bsgrags pa ni/ 'di nas brtsams te khyod kyi dpal he ru ka nga yin gyis/ ngas gang byos shig bya ba de khyod kyis bya dgos so/ khyod kyis nga la brnyas pa'i las ma byed cig khyod mi bde ba ma spangs bar tshe'i dus byas nas sems can dmyal bar ltung bar 'gyur ta re/ ye shes dbab pa'i don du gsol ba gdab pa/ dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyis byin gyis rlobs la dpal he ru ka bdag la dbab par mdzad du gsol/ lan gsum/ ye shes med pa mi btsal/ yod pa mi spang*/ ma byung ba la 'dun pa mi bskyed/ byung ba'i nyams gang yang mi dgag par shes pa lhod glod la zhog cig byas/ bdud rtsi lnga/ byi la'i brun/ bud med bzang mo'i zla mtshan sbags pa'i ras bsregs/ rol mo'i sgra/ bla ma dang gtso bo mi phyed pa'i gnas gsum las 'od zer 'phros rang gi gnas gsum du zhugs pas lus mer gyis zhu bar bsam/ oṃ tiṣ+ṭha ma hā kro ta ā be sha ya hūm̐/ oṃ shrī he ru kā ya bid+yā ma he bid+yā rā dzā dhīḥm he swā hā/ zhes bzlas/ yang dag par ni zhugs pa dag /dang*/ bsgrub 'dod shin tu mnyam gzhag pas/ zhes 'byung bas so/ phebs na tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra zhes brjod cing spyi bor rdo rje rgya gram gyi rnam par bzhag ste brtan par bya'o/

de nas dkyil 'khor gyi kha dog cir mthong zhes dri/ dkar po la sogs pa sna tshogs su mthong bas phrin las bzhi 'grub par brda sprad/ lho'i phyogs su gnas pas/ yang dag pa yi dkyil 'khor 'dir// bdag nyid rab tu gzhug par bya// lha yi rigs kyi rim pa dag /bsod nams ji ltar de bzhin shog /'di yis dngos grub gang 'grub dang*// rigs ni gang gi snod du 'gyur// 'di yis bsod nams ci yod pa// dkyil 'khor 'dir ni de bzhin shog /ces slob dpon gyis bden pa'i stobs brjod/ slob mas bum pa'i mtshan ma'am lha grangs kyi tshom bu logs su byas pa skad cig gis lhar dmigs pa la/ pra tits+tsha badz+ra hoḥ zhes pas dor/ lha de'i mtshan ma dang de dang nye bar babs na'ang de'i rigs su shes par bya'o// he ru ka dpal deng khyod kyi// mig 'byed par ni brtson par mdzad// phye ba thams cad mthong 'gyur ba'i// rdo rje'i mig ni bla na med// oṃ badz+ra ne trā a pa ha ra pa tra laṃ hrīḥ zhes pas gdong g.yogs bsal/ dkyil 'khor bzang po 'di la ltos// da ni dad pa rab tu skyed/ khyod ni rnal 'byor ma rigs skye// sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis brlabs// 'gro ba'i phun sum tshogs kun dang*// dngos grub kun khyod mngon du 'gyur/ rnam dag ni/ ri mo nyi shu phyogs bzhi pa// de ni dpa' bo'i rnam pa'o// 'khor lo'i rtsibs ni rnal 'byor ma// lte ba rdo rje phag mo ste// sa bon zhes grags khrag 'thung mchog /'dab ma mkha' 'gro ma'i rang bzhin// dkyil 'khor dkyil 'khor rnams kyi mchog /sum cu rtsa bdun rnam dag pa'o/ /zhes pas lha dang gzhal yas khang gnyis su med pas de dag kyang byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun du bzhag pa bshad par bya ba'o/ de nas he ru ka dpal rgyud// sems rgyud dri med yin par bshad// dag pa'i chos kyi sprul pa ni// phag mo'i gzugs su bstan pa yin// thabs dang shes rab sbyor ba las// de nyid dang ni thams cad byung*// me long la sogs rnam pa bzhi// pad+ma'i 'dab gnas rnal 'byor ma// mkha' 'gro ma sogs pad+mar gnas// mā ma kī sogs bzang mo yin// thod pa'i dum bu sogs 'khor gsum// nyi shu rtsa bzhi gnyis med yin// sems can 'khor ba las sgrol bas// dpa' bo nyid ni yin par bshad/

khro bo rnam rgyal la sogs kun// sgo dang mtha' yi mtshams rnams su// sna tshogs 'dul ba'i thabs can gyis// sems can don la brtson par mdzad/ ces lha'i dag pa bshad/ dbang bskur ba la/ bum dbang*/ gsang dbang*/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang*/ bzhi pa'i dbang bzhi/ dang po la/ rdo rje slob ma'i dbang*// slob dpon gyi dbang gnyis kyi dang po/ sdom 'byung las/ chu dang cod pan rdo rje dang*// dril bu ming gi dbang bskur te// dbang lnga de bzhin gshegs bdag nyid// ces pa'i chu dbang ni/ he ru ka dpal dbang bskur ba// 'gro ba skyob phyir gzi brjid can// ji ltar yon tan 'byung gnas stsal// de bzhin bdag la de stsol zhig /lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ lho sgor seng ge'i khri rang nyid 'khod pa'i steng du gdugs dkar po gser gyi yu ba can phub/ der sngar gyi me tog phog pa'i lhas sngar phul ba'i me tog gi phreng ba 'di/ oṃ pra tī grih+ṇa s+t+waṃ i maṃ sa twa ma hā ba la/ zhes pas spyi bor bcings/ slob dpon nus pa dang ldan pas dkyil 'khor lha mngon du sprul des sam/ yang na bum pa sngags yungs kar gyis bskul bas de nyid nam mkha' la 'phags pas sam/ gzhan du snying ga'i sa bon gyis dbang lha bkug nas bskur bar bya'o/ de la oṃ khaṇ+ḍa ro hi hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ kyis bsangs/ oṃ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las mi bskyod pa sku mdog sngon po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa phyag rgya drug gis brgyan cing dar dang rin po ches spras pa rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas thugs kyi bde mchog de lta bu dang dang dbang lha de bzhin gshegs pa lnga dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥdabang lha spyi bor pho brang btab ste bzhugs pa rnams kyi thugs ka nas spros pa'i mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis rin po che'i bum pa bdud rtsi lnga'i chus gang bas/

bum pa thams cad kyi chu rnam rgyal du bsdus te/ rdo rje dang bcas pa'i khu tshur gyis bum pa de spyi bor bzhag /g.yon pas dril bu 'khrol bas/ dbang bskur rdo rje chen po ni/ khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa// sangs rgyas kun gyis gsang gsum gyi// gnas las byung ba sbyin par bya// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta u da ka a bhi ṣiñtsa tu māṃ/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// lha rnams kun gyis khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yis// de bzhin dag pa'i sku khrus gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ khrus byas/ rnam shes phung po rnam dag pa'i// nyon mongs zhe sdang sbyong byed pa// me long lta bu'i ye shes kyis// dpal ldan thugs kyi dbang bskur ro/ zhes dgos pa bshad/ khaṇ+ḍa ro hi sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ bdag dang dbang rdzas gyi cod pan dar dpyangs dang bcas pa mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las rdo rje nyi ma sku mdog dmar po rin po che dang dril bu 'dzin pa phyag rgya drug gis brgyan cing dar dang rin po ches spras pa rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas yon tan gyi bde mchog de lta bu dang dbang lha de bzhin gshegs pa lnga dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dbang lha spyi bor pho brang btab ste bzhugs pa rnams kyi thugs ka nas spros pa'i mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis rin po che'i cod pan dar dpyangs gyis mdzes pas/ ral pa'i thor tshugs kyis brgyan pa// sangs rgyas kun gyis bsngags pa yis// rin chen dag gis dbu rgyan dang*// dar dpyangs dbang bskur sbyin par bya// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta rat+na mu ku ṭa a bhi ṣiñtsa tu maṃ/ tshor ba'i phung po rnam dag pa// nyon mongs nga rgyal sbyong byed pa// mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes kyi// dpal ldan yon tan dbang bskur ro/

khaṇ+ḍa ro hi sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ bdag dbang rdzas kyi rdo rje mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du gyur stong pa'i ngang las 'od dpag med sku mdog mthing ga pad+ma dang dril bu 'dzin pa phyag rgya drug gis brgyan cing dar dang rin po ches spras pa rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas gsung gi bde mchog de lta bu dang dbang lha de bzhin gshegs pa lnga dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dbang lha spyi bor pho brang btab ste bzhugs pa rnams gyi thugs ka nas spros pa'i mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis rdo rje g.yas su gtad// sangs rgyas kun gyi rdo rje'i dbang*// de ring khyod la bskur bar bya// sangs rgyas kun nas rab bsgrub phyir// rdo rje 'di ni khyod kyis gzung*// oṃ badz+ra a dhi pa ti staṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa mi tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ 'du shes phung po rnam dag pa// nyon mongs 'dod chags sbyong byed pa// so sor rtog pa'i ye shes gyis// dpal ldan gsung gi dbang bskur ro/ khaṇ+ḍa ro hi sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ bdag dang dbang rdzas kyi dril bu mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las rta mchog sku mdog ljang ga sna tshogs rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa phyag rgya drug gis brgyan cing dar dang rin po ches spras pa rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas phrin las kyi bde mchog de lta bu dang dbang lha de bzhin gshegs pa lnga dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dbang lha spyi bor pho brang btab ste bzhugs pa rnams kyi thugs ka nas spros pa'i mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis dril bu g.yon du gtad/ 'di ste sangs rgyas thams cad kyis// shes rab dbyangs kyi rjes 'gror bshad/ khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcang*// byang chub mchog tu rgyal bar bzhed// oṃ badz+ra satwa a dhi pa tis+t+waṃ/

a bhi ṣiñtsa mi tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ 'du byed phung po rnam dag pa// nyon mongs phrag dog sbyong byed pa// bya ba nan tan ye shes kyis// dpal ldan phrin las dbang bskur ro/ khaṇ+ḍa ro hi sa bsangs/ swā bhā wa sa sbyangs/ bdag nyid mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du gyur// stong pa'i ngang las rnam par snang mdzad sku mdog ser po 'khor lo dang dril bu 'dzin pa phyag rgya drug gis brgyan cing dar dang rin po ches spras pa rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas sku'i bde mchog de lta bu dang dbang lha de bzhin gshegs pa lnga dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dbang lha spyi bor pho brang btab ste bzhugs pa rnams kyis thugs ka nas spros pa'i mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis mgo bor rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas/ sangs rgyas kun gyis ming gi dbang*// de ring khyod la bskur bar bya// sangs rgyas kun nas rab sgrub phyir// rdo rje ming 'di khyod kyis longs/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shrī he ru ka a dhi pa ti s+t+waṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa mi/ shrī he ru ka nā ma a bhi ṣe ka ta kye dpal me tog phog pa de'i ming btags so/ gzugs kyi phung po rnam dag pa// nyon mongs gti mug sbyong byed cing*// chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes kyis// dpal ldan sku yi dbang bskur ro// de ltar dbang bskur ba 'di thob pa'i rtags kyi 'char tshul ma rig pa dang mi mthun pa'i rig pa bskyed pas/ phung po tha mal du rtogs pa las log nas lha sku sgyu ma tsam du 'char ba de'i lta ba ni snang sems dbyer med du shes pa/ sgom pa sems stong rkyang du mi 'jog par gsal ba lha'i 'khor lo slong ba spyod pa kun tu bzang po/ dam tshig bdud rtsi lnga bsten te 'dod yon lam du khyer ba/ sdom pa tha mal gyi snang ba sdom pa'o// de'i phyir 'di tsam gyis dbang bskur bas kyang phyi rnal 'byor gyi rgyud man/

'chad pa la dbang ba yin no/ /slob dpon du 'gyur ba de yang dang po sngags kyi sku bsgrubs nas phyis ye shes kyi sku sgrub par 'os pa'i slob ma dag la yin la/ 'di la 'di'i mthar mtha' brten bzhi sbyin par gsungs te/ mchog bsgrub pa'i bskyed rim gyi rdo rje slob dpon du mi 'os pa'i phyir dang*/ de tsam gyis sngags kyi dngos grub bsgrub pa'i snod du 'gyur bas so// de'i phyir bum pa'i dbang rang la yang*/ rnal 'byor rgyud dngos zin dang mthun pa dang khyad par gnyis su shes par bya'o/ /rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang zhu ba'i yon du/ ri rab gling bzhi gling phran nyi zla lcags rir bcas// rin chen sna bdun gter gyi bum pas legs bkangs shing*// bdag lus longs spyod snang srid bcas pa kun phul bas/ thugs rje chen pos dgongs te bzhes nas bskyab tu gsol// gu ru i daṃ maṇ+ḍa la kaṃ nir+ya tā ya mi/ dpa' bo chen po mi ldog pa'i// dbang bskur ba ni bdag la stsol// sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir// rtag tu bdag ni slob dpon 'gyur/

/zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab bo/ sdom 'byung las/ phyir mi ldog pa'ang sbyin bya ste// gdugs dang gdan dang rig pa sogs// rdo rje dril sogs yang dag ldan// yang dag rdzogs pa'i slob dpon dbang*// rdo rje sems dpa' phyir mi ldog /sbyin bya bum pa yang dag ldan// zhes rig sbyor gyi dbang*/ bum dbang*/ slob dpon rab 'byams kyi dbang gsum dngos gzhi/ 'dogs bzhi mtha' brten no// dang por rig sbyor gyi dbang ni/ shes rab bcu drug lon pa la// lag pa dag gis yang dag 'khyud// rdo rje dril bu mnyam sbyor ba// slob dpon dbang du rab tu brjod/ /ces de nyid gsum po 'di shes na/ slob dpon du 'os pas de gsum bsgrub pa'i phyir yin pas/ slob ma cher gyur shes nas ni// ston pas de la gnang ba sbyin/ /zhes brtag gnyis kyi lung 'phro de nyid du byung bas/ gnyis pa der bsko ba dang*/ gsum pa bskos pa de la bya ba 'di lta bu byed dgos so zhes brjod pa yin pa la/ sdom 'byung du dkrugs// rtsa ba'i rgyud bzhin 'grel bas 'khrugs bsal ba yin no/ de'i phyir brtag gnyis las/ rdo rje rab gnas rdo rje nyid// che dang dril bu chen po gzung*// de ring rdo rje slob dpon 'gyur// slob ma bsdu ba nyid du gyis/ /zhes gsungs pa'o/ sku skye med kyi dbang 'khyud pa'i phyag rgya bca'/ yid kyi lus ni brtan byed pa// de ni phyag rgya zhes su bsgrags// gang gi lus kun brtan byed pa/ des na phyag rgyar rab tu bsgrags/ zhes dang rig ma/ gsung brjod med kyi dbang*/ dril bu g.yon du gtad/ srid pa ngo bo nyid kyis dag /ngo bo nyid kyis srid bral byas// rang bzhin dag pa'i sems dpa' ni// srid pa'i dam pa byed par 'gyur/ /bsrub bya de'i skye gnas/ thugs rtog med kyi dbang*/ thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni// rdo rje sems dpa' dga' ba che// kun tu bzang po kun bdag nyid// rdo rje snyems tshul bdag po'i bdag

/srub byed rang gi rtags/ srub byed 'dis mtshon nas chos thams cad zung 'jug tu brda sprod pa'o// de'i phyir sdom 'byung las/ dril sogs yang dag ldan gyi sogs sgra ni mnyam par sbyor ba ste thabs shes zung 'jug tu rtogs na sngags kyi slob dpon gyi 'os so zhes ston pa/ da ni bum dbang slob dpon 'os pa de la/ 'og tu seṅge'i khri pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan/ steng du gdugs phub pa'i 'og tu/ rang nyid skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das dpal 'khor lo sdom pa in+d+ra ni la dang mtshungs pa'i sku mdog sngon po zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis pa zhabs g.yas brkyang bas dus mtshan ma dmar mo'i nu ma mnan pa/ g.yon cung zad bskum pas 'jigs byed sngon po'i dpral ba mnan pa/ rtsa zhal sngon po/ g.yon zhal ljang khu/ rgyab zhal dmar po/ g.yas zhal ser po/ zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ nor bu dang sna tshogs rdo rje dang zla ba phyed pas mtshan pa'i ral pa'i thor tshugs can/ dbu re re la mi mgo skam po lnga lnga'i dbu rgyan dang rlon pa lnga cu'i do shal byas pa/ 'khor lo dang*/ rna cha dang*/ mgul rgyan dang*/ gdu bu dang*/ ska rags dang*/ thal chen te phyag rgya drug gis brgyan pa/ zhal mche ba gtsigs shing 'jigs par byed pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can// gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan pa ste/ sku dpa' ba dang*/ sgeg pa dang*/ 'jigs su rung ba dang*/ gsung rgod pa dang*/ gshe ba dang*/ rngam pa dang*/ thugs snying rje ba dang*/ zhi ba dang*/ ngo mtshar ba'o// phyag bcu gnyis kyis spras pa'i dang po gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ de'i 'og ma gnyis kyis glang po che'i pags pa rlon pa gdeng nas 'dzin pa/ g.yas kyi gsum pa na ḍā ma ru/ bzhi pa na dgra s+t+wa/ lnga pa na gri gug /drug pa na mdung rtse gsum pa/ g.yon gyi gsum pa na kha ṭ+wām̐ ga /bzhi pa na thod pa khrag gis gang ba/ lnga pa na rdo rje'i zhags pa/

drug pa na tshangs pa'i mgo bo gdong bzhi pa bsnams pa/ de'i pang na yum rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/ in+t+ras gang ba'i thod pa 'dzin pa'i phyag g.yon pas yab la 'khyud pa/ g.yas rdo rje dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub steng gi nam mkha' la 'phyar ba mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ thod skam lnga cu'i do shal byas pa gcer bu skra grol zhing phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ byin pa gnyis kyis bcom ldan 'das kyi brla gnyis la 'khyud pa/ gnyis ka'ang ye shes me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs par gyur/ oṃ haḥ gtso bo'i snying gar rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po dkar ser dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas gsum rdo rje ḍā ma ru tshangs mgo /g.yon gsum dril bu thod pa khaṭ+wām̐ ga bsnams pa/ na ma hi/ dpral bar rnam par snang mdzad ser po/ swa ha hu/ spyi bor rin chen 'byung gnas dmar po/ bau ṣaṭa he/ phrag pa gnyis la he ru ka nag po/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hoḥ spyan gsum la 'od dpag med mthing ga /phaṭ haṃ/ yan lag thams cad la don yod grub pa ljang gu /de thams cad zhal gcig phyag bzhi'i dang po gnyis/ 'khor lo/ rin po che/ rdo rje pad+ma/ sna tshogs rdo rje dang de'i dril bu thugs kar bsnol ba/ lhag ma gnyis ḍā ma ru dang thod pa/ dpa' bo'i chas kyis brgyan te g.yas brkyang gis bzhugs pa/ oṃ haḥ na ma hi/ swa ha hu/ bau ṣaṭa he/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hoḥphaṭ haṃ/ oṃ baṃ/ yum gyi lte bar phag mo dmar mo dmar ljang ser ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas gsum gri gug khaṭ+wām̐ ga lcags kyu/ g.yon gsum thod pa/ tshangs mgo /zhags pa bsnams pa/ haṃ yoṃ snying gar gshin rje ma sngon mo/ hriṃ moṃ mgrin par rmongs byed ma dkar mo/ hrīṃ hrīṃ mtshog mar skyod byed ma ser mo/ hūm̐ hūm̐ spyi gtsug tu skrag byed ma ljang gu/ phaṭ phaṭ yan lag thams cad la tsaṇ+ḍī ka dud kha/ de thams cad zhal gcig phyag bzhi'i dang po gnyis gri gug dang thod pa/

lhag ma gnyis khaṭ+wām̐ ga dang ḍā ma ru dpa' mo'i chas kyis brgyan te g.yon brkyang gis bzhugs pa/ oṃ baṃ/ haṃ yoṃ/ hriṃ moṃ/ hriṃ hriṃ/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ phaṭ phaṭ/ yab kyi gsang ba hūm̐ las rdo rje sngon po/ baṃ las nor bu dmar po phaṭ ser pos bu ga bkag pa/ yum gyi mkha' āḥlas pad+ma dmar po oṃ las ze'u 'bru sngon po phaṭ ser pos bu ga bkag pa/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas thugs kyi bde mchog de lta bu dang dbang lha de bzhin gshegs pa lnga dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dbang lha spyi bor pho brang btab ste bzhugs pa rnams kyi thugs ka nas spros pa'i mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis rin po che'i bum pa bdud rtsi lnga'i chus gang bas/ dbang bskur rdo rje chen po ni/ khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa// sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang gsum gyi// gnas las byung ba sbyin par bya// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta u da ka a bhi ṣiñtsa tu maṃ/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyi ni// lha rnams kun gyis khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yis// de bzhin dag pa'i sku khrus gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐/ khrus bya 'di sdom 'byung las rig pa sogs kyi sogs sgras/ chas su bcug pa/ phyag mtshan gyis spyod pa'i brtul zhugs sbyin pa bshad de/ rtsa ba'i sngags kyi dpa' bo gang*// tshangs pa'i skud la sogs pa btag /lha yi snying po'i gsang sngags kyi// brgya phyed phreng bas brgyan pa yin// thod pa'i dum bu la sogs kun// lus kyi khams su btag par bya// dpa' bo'i go cha drug gis ni// rgya ni lus ni mdzes pa yin// rdo rje phag mo sogs sngags gang*// mgul chu mgrin pa mdzes pa ste// sangs rgyas kun gyi mkha' 'gro ma'i// pags pa'i gos ni 'dzin pa'i mchog /yi ge bdun gyi gsang sngags kyi// rna chas snyan ni mdzes pa yin// rnal 'byor ma drug gsang sngags gang*// ska rags rgyas pas brgyan pa yin// 'khor lo kun gyis rnal 'byor ma'i// sngags ni lag pa'i thod pa yin// rnam par snang mdzad yum sngags gang*// thod pas mgo bo brgyan pa yin/

/zhes pas chas rnams gtad/ kha ṭ+wām̐ ga ni lha yi sku// shes rab ḍā ma ru ru bshad/ /brjod pa phyag mtshan gyis/ nyin mo bcom ldan dpa' bo ste// mtshan mo bcom ldan ma brtag bya// mi bya ci yang yod ma yin// rtag tu mi bsam yod ma yin// mi za ci yang yod min la// dge dang mi dge mi smra med// bdag nyid ji bzhin 'gro de bzhin// bdag ji 'dra bar gzhan de bzhin// de ltar rnam bsams rnal 'byor bdag /'jigs pa thams cad rnam spangs te// dpa' bo seṅge bzhin du spyod// bsam pa thams cad rdzogs byed yin// he ru ka dpal gzhir gnas pa'i// yan lag bskyod pa ji snyed dang*// tshig tu brjod pa ji snyed pa// de snyed phyag rgya gsang sngags yin// rigs lnga'i kun tu spyod pa ni// rigs gcig tu ni spyad par bya// de ltar shes pa'i bdag nyid can// go 'phang mchog tu 'gro bar 'gyur/ /zhes spyod pa'i brtul zhugs sbyin/ slob dpon rab 'byams kyi dbang la/ nor bu gtad de/ gzung bya rnam shes ye shes ni// bla mas bstan la brtson bya ste/ phyi rol gyi ni bstan bcos pa// lam de shin tu ring ba yin// rnal 'byor pa rnams thams cad kyis// bla ma'i bsnyen bkur la brtson gyis// brgyud pa yid bzhin nor bus gzhan rjes su 'dzin tshul lo/ mar sbrang bgos pa'i mig thur gyis mig 'byed pa'i tshul/ ji ltar mig mkhan rgyal po yis// 'jig rten rab rib bsal ba ltar// bu khyod kyis ni mi shes pa'i// rab rib rgyal ba rnams kyis sel/ /chos thams cad la blta ba me long bstan/ chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ dag cing gsal la rnyog pa med// gzung du med cing brjod du med// rgyu dang las la kun tu 'byung*// ngo bo med cing gnas med pa// de ltar chos rnams shes gyis la// sems can don ni bla med byos// 'on kyang rnal 'byor ma rigs skye// chos de dag kyang sgyu ma tsam du shes par bya ba/

/dung 'khor lo po ti gtad/ bya ba spyod pa mdo sde dang*// rnal 'byor gsang sogs dbye ba nyid// 'jig rten kun la bshad pa ni// byang chub don gyi rgyu nyid yin// nga yis 'jug par bshad pa ni// tshogs gnyis gnyis su med pa yin/ /skas gtad/ thams cad bden pa gnyis la ni// brten par ngas ni sngon bshad pa// rnal 'byor pa yi dngos grub kyi// bsgom pa mngon du 'gyur ba yin/ /zhes smin lam/ gri gug gtad/ spros pa kun la dmigs nas ni// spros pas spros pa med par bya// rgyud rnams kun tu gsang ba gang*// sprul pa rnams kyis de nyid bstan/ /grol lam/ zas kyis gang ba'i thod pa gtad/ gnyis med ye shes sems ldan pas// mi bya ba ni ci yang med// mi rtog bdag nyid sems kyis ni// 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga rnams spyad/ /tshogs/ sbrul dang mi gzugs gtad/ sems ni gnas gyur rnal 'byor pa// mya ngan 'das pa rtag mi bya// de ltar spyod pa'i skyes mchog ni// sdig pa thams cad rnam dag 'gyur// 'jig rten 'di'am pha rol tu// 'dis ni sangs rgyas nyid mthong 'gyur// ji ltar sngar bshad sdig pa rnams// spang bar bya ba'i mtshan nyid yin// gang gi 'di bsgom rnal 'byor pa// 'dod pa'i bde ba thams cad ster/ /sdig pa spang dge ba bsgrub/ nyi ma gtad/ gnyid log ma log ldang ba dang*// za'am 'gro ba'i chos spyod pa// gang yin de ni rnam dgod na// 'jig rten gsum yang mi g.yo'o/ /dgag sgrub mi bya ba'i/ mtsho gtad/ ji ltar nang gi bdag nyid shes// phyi yi dkyil 'khor dam pa yin// rnam dgod ji ltar sbyar ba ni// snying po thams cad bsdus pa ste/ gnas sogs lus su lta ba/ de nas/ mi bzad las ni gang gang gis// skye bo rnams ni 'ching 'gyur ba// thabs dang bcas pa de nyid kyis// srid pa'i 'ching ba las grol 'gyur// 'khor ba'i pha rol brgal nas ni// ci 'dod ye shes can du 'gyur// ma dag pa thabs kyis zin pa las dag snang gzhan med par ngo sprad/

dpag bsam gyi shing gtad/ de nas pha rol phyin drug dang*// byang chub phyogs ni sum cu bdun// gnas sogs sa ni bcu rnams dang*// che mchog lha yi bdag nyid can// dngos po gang dang gang gis ni// mi rnams yid ni yang dag sbyor// de ni de yi dngos 'gyur te// sna tshogs gzugs ni nor bu 'dra/ /lha bsgom pa/ phreng ba gtad/ ā li kā li ma gtogs par// gal te chos 'di 'dod na ni// de yi ngal ba don med de// 'bras bu thob par mi 'gyur ro/ /bzlas pa/ pad+ma/ 'bad de 'dod bya dmigs nas ni// de bzhin nyid bdag rnal 'byor pas// ji ltar he ru ka ye shes// ji 'dod pa ni yongs su spyod/ /rdzogs rim/ 'khor lo gtad/ rna bas ring nas thos pa dang*// skad cig gis mthong rnal 'byor pa// chos 'di ji ltar shes na ni// bsam pa thams cad rdzogs byed yin/ /chos ston pa/ mda' gzhu gtad/ rgyud 'di yi ni rnal 'byor pa// bden pa gnyis la yang dag brten// sems can thams cad bsad nas ni// longs spyod kun la nyer spyod bya/ /bdud 'dul ba/ mchod rdzas gtad/ dgun zla 'bring po nas brtsams te// zla ba re la'ang gzung bar bya// gnyis med gnyis med 'khor lo bcas// tshes bcu la ni de rab mchod/ /rgya gram/ zhi dang rgyas dang dbang dang dgug /sdang bar bya dang gnod sogs dang*// bsad dang bskrad pa de dag ste// phrin las thams cad sgrub par gyis/ /ral gri/ ral gri mig sman sa 'og dang*// mchil lahwam de bzhin ril bu dang*// mi snang ba dang bcud kyis len// de dag ci dgar sgrub par gyis/ /dung byin/ ji ltar sngon gyi rgyal ba ltar// snyan pa phyogs bcur sgrog par gyis/ /mthar brten/ sdom 'byung las/ brtul zhugs dang ni lung bstan nyid// rjes gnang dang ni dbugs dbyung dang*// zhes bshad pa bzhi'i dang po rdo rje'i brtul zhugs ni/ rang nyid he ru ka nag por gyur pa las// 'di ste dpa' bo thams cad kyi// he ru ka dpal phyag na gnas/
