khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcang*// he ru ka yi brtul zhugs bstan// oṃ sarba bī ra yo gi nī s+t+waṃ sid+dh+ya badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha/ e ṣa ya s+t+waṃ dhā ra yā mi badz+ra satwa hrīḥhi hi hi hi swā hā/ slob dpon shākya thub par bsam chos gos kyi grwa ri dwags kyi rna ba ltar g.yon kyis bzung g.yas pa skyabs sbyin gyi phyag rgyas/ khrag 'thung rdo rje de bzhin gshegs// ngas ni khyod la lung bstan bya// srid pa ngan 'gro las bton te// srid pa shin tu dag phyir ro// sarba ta thā ga ta sid+dh+ya sa ma ya s+t+waṃ bhūr bhū baḥswaḥ kye dpal che ge mo rdo rje zhes pa/ mkha' 'gro dang mkha' 'gro ma kun gyis mgrin gcig tu bla na med pa rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu lung ston par byed de dad par bya'o/ zhes brjod pa lung bstan no/ de nas 'khor lo sdom pa rigs lngar gsal btab ste/ 'khor lo la sogs pa gtad nas/

sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir// 'jig rten khams ni thams cad du// bya ba spyod tshul gsang ba yi// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bgyi// sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir// 'jig rten khams ni thams cad du// bya ba spyod tshul gsang ba yi// rdo rje'i 'khor lo bskor bar bgyi// sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir// 'jig rten khams ni thams cad du// bya ba spyod tshul gsang ba yi// rin chen 'khor lo bskor bar gyi// sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir// 'jig rten khams ni thams cad du// bya ba spyod tshul gsang ba yi// pad+ma'i 'khor lo bskor bar bgyi// sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir// 'jig rten khams ni thams cad du// bya ba spyod tshul gsang ba yi// ral gri'i 'khor lo bskor bar bgyi/ /zhes rigs lnga'i rjes gnang ngo*/ gsang ba mchog gi dkyil 'khor du// mchog tu rab zhugs mthong bas na// deng khyod sdig pa thams cad las// rnam grol bzang por gyur pas gnas/ /sdig pa dag par dbugs phyung*/ sangs rgyas kun gyis mnyam gsungs pa'i// rjes gnang mchog tu dbugs dbyung ba// dngos grub dam tshig sdom pa ni// 'di dag rtag tu srung bar gyis/ phyir mi ldog par dbugs phyung*/ slob mas phyag byas nas/ gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa// de dag thams cad bdag gis bgyid/ /rang gi lus kyang yon du 'bul dgos na// bdog pa thams cad btang ba lta ci smos zhes bsams nas mnyes par byas te/ deng dus bdag tshe 'bras bu yod// bdag gi gson pa'ang 'bras bur bcas// de ring sangs rgyas rigs su skyes// sangs rgyas sras su da gyur to/ /zhes khas blangs pa brjod do/ gsang dbang gi phyir ma rdo rje slob dpon du 'os phul la/ slob dpon yab yum gyis tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor legs par bsgrubs la/ der bla ma longs sku'i bdag nyid can la gsang dbang zhu ba'i yon du/ ri rab gling bzhi gling phran nyi zla lcags ri'i brgyan// rin chen sna bdun gter gyi bum pas legs bkangs shing*// bdag lus longs spyod snang srid bcas pa kun phul bas// thugs rje chen pos dgongs te bzhes nas bskyab tu gsol// gu ru i daṃ maṇ+ḍa la kaṃ nir+ya tā ya mi

zhes maṇ+ḍal phul/ gsol ba gdab pa ni/ khyod kyi zhabs kyi bka' drin gyis// phyir mi ldog pa'i dbang bskur thob// de ring gsang ba'i dbang bskur ba// mgon pos bdag la stsal du gsol/ /zhes lan gsum gyis so/ gsang dbang la bzhi ste/ bla ma gsal stong gi dbang*/ snang stong 'dzin med kyi dbang*/ byang sems bde stong gi dbang*/ thig le stong pa brjod med kyi dbang ngo*/ dang po/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das dpal 'khor lo sdom pa in+d+ra nī la dang mtshungs pa'i sku mdog sngon po zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis pa zhabs g.yas brkyang bas dus mtshan ma dmar mo'i nu ma mnan pa/ g.yon cung zad bskum pas 'jigs byed sngon po'i dpral ba mnan pa/ rtsa zhal sngon po/ g.yon zhal ljang khu/ rgyab zhal dmar po/ g.yas zhal ser po/ zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ nor bu dang sna tshogs rdo rje dang zla ba phyed pas mtshan pa'i ral pa'i thor tshugs can/ dbu re re la mi mgo skam po lnga lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal byas pa/ 'khor lo dang*/ rna cha dang*/ mgul rgyan dang*/ gdu bu dang*/ ska rags dang*/ thal chen te phyag rgya drug gis brgyan pa/ zhal mche ba gtsigs shing 'jigs par byed pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can// gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan pa ste/ sku dpa' ba dang*/ sgeg pa dang*/ 'jigs su rung ba dang*/ gsung rgod pa dang*/ gshe ba dang*/ rngam pa dang*/ thugs snying rje ba dang*/ zhi ba dang*/ ngo mtshar ba'o// phyag bcu gnyis kyis spras pa'i dang po gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ de'i 'og ma gnyis kyis glang po che'i pags pa rlon pa gdeng nas 'dzin pa/ g.yas kyi gsum pa na ḍā ma ru/ bzhi pa na dgra s+t+wa/ lnga pa na gri gug /drug pa na mdung rtse gsum pa/ g.yon gyi gsum pa na khaṭ+wām̐ ga bzhi pa na thod pa khrag gis gang ba/ lnga pa na rdo rje'i zhags pa/

drug pa na tshangs pa'i mgo bo gdong bzhi pa bsnams pa/ de'i pang na yum rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/ in+t+ras gang ba'i thod pa 'dzin pa'i phyag g.yon pas yab la 'khyud pa/ g.yas rdo rje dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub steng gi nam mkha' la 'phyar ba/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ thod skam lnga cu'i do shal byas pa gcer bu skra grol zhing phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ byin pa gnyis kyis bcom ldan 'das kyi brla gnyis la 'khyud pa/ gnyis ka'ang ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs par gyur/ gtso bo'i snying gar oṃ haḥ dpral bar na ma hi/ spyi bor swa ha hu/ phrag pa gnyis la bau ṣaṭa he/ spyan gsum la hūm̐ hūm̐ hoḥ yan lag thams cad la phaṭ haṃḥ gtso mo'i lte ba oṃ baṃ/ snying gar haṃ yoṃ/ mgrin par hriṃ moṃ/ dpral bar hriṃ hriṃ/ spyi gtsug tu hūm̐ hūm̐/ yan lag thams cad la phaṭ phaṭ/ yab kyi gsang ba hūm̐ las rdo rje sngon po/ baṃ las nor bu dmar po phaṭ ser pos bu ga bkag pa/ yum gyi mkha' aḥlas pad+ma dmar po oṃ las ze'u 'bru sngon po/ phaṭ ser pos bu ga bkag pa/ stong pa nyid gsal bar langs pa de yang sgyu ma tsam du lta ba'o/ rgyas par na tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor bsgrubs/ der slob ma gzhug pa yin no/ gnyis pa/ snyoms par zhugs pas yab yum gyi nā ḍi stong phrag bdun cu rtsa gnyis bskul bas phung khams skye mched kyi lha thams cad zhu ba'i thig le gnyis shor gnyis mnyam gyi skabs so/ /gsum pa/ de bha gar btang*/ slob dpon gyis/ sbrang rtsi khrag dang ga pur bcas// tsan dan dmar po sbyar byas pa// rdo rje'i chu dang bsres pa ni// dngos grub thams cad sgrub byed pa'i// de dag bdud rtsi lngar ni gyur// mthe bong srin lag sbyar ba yis// rnal 'byor rig pas rtag tu bza'// zhi ba'i btung ba bzhin myangs na// dngos grub rtag pa thob par 'gyur/

/zhes brjod/ slob ma rtog pa chung na bha ga nas khas blang*/ che na rdzas gzhan dang bsres pa nya lcibs sogs su byin zhes/ dngos su da lta thod pa'i bdud rtsi dam tshig gis ril bu sbyangs pa nas so/ slob mas khar 'thung dus/ lce steng du thod pa/ sna rtser thig le dkar po/ smin mtshams su thig le dmar po de dag sbyor ba byas pas mched pa'i thig les ka pā la gang*/ de lud pas lus gang bar bsam btung ngo*/ bzhi pa/ bar snang du he ru ka yab yum sbyor ba mdzad pa'i mtshams nas byang sems lhung ba bdag gi khar babs/ de nas khong du song bas gnyis su 'dzin pa grol nas sgyu ma lta bus dam tshig thams cad bsten par bya ste/ las rnams kun la thabs bcas shing*// dogs pa med par gang spyod dang*// rnam par mi rtog bsgom pa ni// brtul zhugs rnams kyi mchog gi mchog /ces bsgo bar bya'o/ bla ma chos sku'i bdag nyid can la dbang gsum pa zhu ba'i yon du/ ri rab gling bzhi gling phran nyi zla lcags rir bcas// rin chen sna bdun gter gyi bum pas legs bkangs shing*// bdag lus longs spyod snang srid bcas pa kun 'bul na// thugs rje chen pos dgongs te bzhes nas bskyab tu gsol// gu ru i daṃ maṇ+ḍa la kaṃ nir+ya ta ya mi/ zhes maṇ+ḍal phul/ gsol ba gdab pa ni/ khyod kyi zhabs kyi bka' drin gyis// gsang ba'i dbang bskur legs par thob// de ring shes rab ye shes dbang*// mgon pos bdag la stsal du gsol/ /gsum pa 'di la bzhi/ zag bcas bskul ba'i dbang*/ zag med srub pa'i dbang*/ bde chen 'jo ba'i dbang*/ rtog med ngo sprod kyi dbang ngo*/ dang po/ dbang rten lo nyi shu man/ pad+ma can rnyed na rab/ phyag rgya ma de sangs rgyas thams cad dpang por bzhag ste/ bud med kun gyi sgyu ma'i rgya// 'di ni gnyis med ye shes mchog /rnyed dang bde ba kun mos pas// ngan par spyod pa'ang 'grub par 'gyur// nam mkhar kun tu rgyu grub pas// mkha' 'gro ma zhes rab tu grags// sna tshogs kun tu phyag rgya ni// sna tshogs kun gyi sdom pa yis// mkha' 'gro ma kun mnyam sbyor ba// rdo rje mkha' 'gro zhes byar grub// de nyid med sems rnal 'byor pa// lha la dmigs par byed pa dag

/kun tu gzugs can nyid kyis ni// lugs sogs rnal 'byor skye ba min/ /zhes pas slob ma la gtad/ rang nyid skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das dpal 'khor lo sdom pa in+d+ra ni la dang mtshungs pa'i sku mdog sngon po zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis pa yum dang bcas pa gsal ba la oṃ haḥn ma hiḥswa ha hu/ bauṣaṭa heḥ hūm̐ hūm̐ hoḥphaṭ haṃḥ oṃ baṃ haṃ yoṃ hraṃ moṃ hriṃ hriṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ/ yab kyi gsang ba hūm̐ las rdo rje sngon po/ baṃ las nor bu dmar po phaṭ ser pos bu ga bkag pa/ yum gyi mkha' āḥlas pad+ma dmar po oṃ las ze'u 'bru sngon po phaṭ ser pos bu ga bkag pa/ gnyis ka'i mchan khung g.yas dang srin lag nyi ma la hrīḥdamar po/ mchan khung g.yon dang srin lag zla ba la āḥdakar po/ phan tshun 'khyud de bsnol bas mchan rtsa bsdam/ gnyis ka nas 'od zer dkar dmar byung te dbu mar thim par gyur/ snyoms par zhugs pas rtsa thams cad bskul te dung can kun 'dar gnyis 'phrad pa'i gdong du dbab par bya'o/ /gnyis pa de nas slob dpon gyis/ byang chub sems chen rnal 'byor gang*// rnal 'byor dbang phyug rang nyid gtso// byang chub sems ni rdo rje ste// sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin no/ /zhes brjod nas/ skyes pa'i rtsa sna mthe bong ste nyi ma la hūm̐ sngon po// bud med kyi rtsa srin lag ste zla ba la āḥdakar po srin lag gis mthe bong mnan chags pa dang chags bral 'dres pa'i gnas skabs de la shes pa ma bcos par bzhag pas bde ba de rnam pa'i mchog thams cad dang ldan pa'i stong par 'char te/ de'i tshe/ 'gro ba'i rtsa lag rang bzhin gyis// sna tshogs g.yogs te bde bar bzhugs// de phyir 'bad pa thams cad kyis// sna tshogs tshul gyis mchod par bya/ zhes ngo sprad/ gsum pa/ stong nyid du shar dus lce la a dmar po/ lce'u chung gi g.yas g.yon du hūm̐ sngon po gnyis/ a las 'od 'phros hūm̐ la phog

/'od zer ba thag 'dra bas sbrel te 'od zer dkar dmar yar breng mar breng byed 'phro la lte bar khyur song nas bde ba tsam du'ang mi 'dzin rtog med du blo lhod bzhag pas rnam pa de thams cad rnam pa med pa'i bde chen du 'char te/ 'dis skad cig gis byang chub sems kyi myu gu kha gyen du bltas te snga ma dpe dang 'di don dam pa ste/ shes rab kyi ye shes gnyis po de/ slob dpon gyis/ bdag nyid sangs rgyas thams cad dang*// dpa' bo thams cad nyid yin te// rang gi lha yi sbyor ba yis// bdag nyid rab tu bsgrub par bya/ /zhes ngo sprad/ bzhi pa/ bla ma spyi bor bsgom/ nyon mongs pa lnga'i rang bzhin gyi sems nam mkha' ste dhū tīr blta/ nyi ma'i rtsar kā li dmar po 'od sngon pos sbrel ba/ zla ba'i rtsar ā li dmar po 'od sngon pos sbrel ba/ mthe bong dang gung mos mgrin pa'i rba rlabs bstim gnyid log gdab/ des gnyis snang thams cad btsan thabs su nub pa'i rtog pa med pa mngon du byed do/ de sad nas slob dpon gyis/ 'di yis sangs rgyas thams cad dang*// dpa' bo thams cad nyid dang ni// rdo rje 'dzin pa thams cad du// tshe 'di nyid du 'grub 'gyur zhes// mkha' 'gro kun dang mnyam sbyor ba'i// rdo rje mkha' 'gro bde ba'i mchog /rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs// dpal ldan bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs/ /zhes brjod par bya'o/ bla ma ngo bo nyid sku'i bdag nyid can la dbang bzhi pa zhu ba'i yon du/ ri rab gling bzhi gling phran nyi zla lcags rir bcas// rin chen sna bdun gter gyi bum pas legs bkangs shing*// bdag lus longs spyod snang srid bcas pa kun phul bas// thugs rje chen pos dgongs te bzhes nas bskyab tu gsol// gu ru i daṃ maṇ+ḍa la kaṃ nir+ya tā ya mi/ zhes maṇ+ḍal phul/ gsol ba gdab pa ni/ khyed kyi zhabs kyi bka' drin gyis// shes rab ye shes dbang bskur thob// slar yang shes rab chen po'i dbang*// mgon pos bdag la stsal du gsol/

bzhi pa 'di la'ang bzhi ste/ yul du byed pa'i bzhi pa/ chos nyid don gyi bzhi pa/ 'dra ba mtshon pa'i bzhi pa/ dpe don bsre ba'i bzhi pa'o/ dang po/ thams cad nam mkha'i mtshan nyid de// nam mkha' la ni mtshan nyid med/ khams gsum po ni ma lus pa'i// 'gro kun sgyu ma lta bu yin// sngar rnam pa thams cad pa'i stong gzugs la dmigs pas de thams cad nye bar zhi ba de ni// yul de kho na nyid kyi gnas lugs su mthong ba'o/ /zhes brda sprad/ gnyis pa/ brtan pa dang ni g.yo ba yi// 'gro ba dmigs su med pa ste// mthong ba dang ni rig pa'i dngos// thams cad sgyu ma ji bzhin no// de ltar mthong ba'i yul yul can yang*// nye bar zhi ba nyid kyi phyir// yul dang yul can du lta ba yang mi bden pas sgyu ma lta bu'o/ /zhes brda sprad/ gsum pa/ gang gis blun po 'ching 'gyur ba// 'di ste mkhas rnams rnam par grol// de ltar yul yul can gyi gnyis 'dzin zhig nas chos thams cad chos nyid du 'du'o// 'di kha bde stong sbyar ba'i lhan skyes su gcig go /zhes brda sprad/ bzhi pa phyag rgya'i sbyor ba 'di yis ni// sa gsum ma lus bza' bar bya// gal te gzhan du sbyor ba ni// ma tshang mar me lta bur 'da'/ /zhes slob pa'i sar sgyu ma ji snang ba gnyis med du zos pas rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas lhag ma med pa'i dgra bcom chen po thob bo/ /de yang gang zhe na/ mkha' 'gro kun dngos sems dpa' ni// rdo rje mkha' 'gro bde ba'i mchog /gsang ba mchog gi dgyes pa na// thams cad bdag nyid rtag tu bzhugs// 'di ni rang byung bcom ldan 'das// lhag pa yi ni lha gcig nyid// 'byung gnas sgra tshul nges 'byung rnams// dam tshig spyod pa'i spyod yul yin// 'jig rten gsum du rnyed dka' ba// thog ma dbus mthar yang dag gnas// 'dod chags ma yin chags bral min// dbu mar yang ni mi dmigs so/ /zhes pa de'o zhes brda sprad do/

mthar khyod kyis srog chags gsad par bya// rdzun gyi tshig kyang smra bar bya// ma byin par yang khyod kyis long*// gzhan gyi bud med bsten par gyis/ /zhes dam tshig bsgrag nam mkha'i dbyings rnams kun nas gang ba'i spos kyi chu gter 'dod dgu'i dpal 'byung rin chen pad+mo rin chen 'od 'byin rgyas pas khyab pa'i snying por nor bu'i 'khor yug gi /nang na zhing khams rgya mtsho sa gzhi rin chen las grub rim gyis gzhol ba bkod legs ma lus bkod pa'i phul gyis 'jig rten khams re'ang 'dod yon rmad byung 'phyur ba gang*// mtha' yas sangs rgyas zhing gis bskor zhing kun bzang mchod sprin ma tshang med pa'i rgyan gyis rnam par brgyan pa'i rdul rer rgyal ba sras bcas mdzad pa thams cad snang ba can// gcig tu 'du zhing so sor ma 'dres byin gyis brlabs pa'i rnam 'phrul ji bzhin de dag bdag gi dge ba'i sems kyis sprul te dpal ldan bla mar dad pas 'bul bar bgyi// zhing khams rgya mtshor rdul rer rdul snyed kyi// sangs rgyas zhing dang kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin// kun gyis rgyan ldan ji snyed 'od 'phro'i rtser// rgyal ba sras bcas rnam thar kun snang zhing*// 'khor zhi'i 'dod dgu ma tshang med 'dus pa// chos dbyings thams cad rgyas par 'gengs pa'i 'phrul// nam mkha'i khams khyab srid pa'i mthar gnas nas// chos kyi rgyal po mchod pas mnyes gyur cig /gu ru i daṃ maṇ+ḍa la kaṃ nir+ya ta ya mi/

ces maṇ+ḍal yon dang bcas pas gtang rag btang*/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i ston mo gnyis gang byed kyang rung*/ bdag bskyed bzhin gtor ma btang tshogs kyi bdag po'i mdun du stag la sogs pa'i g.yang gzhi'i steng du chang dang bza' ba rnams bshams te/ bdud rtsi ril bu btab pa byin gyis brlabs pa'i chang gis bsang gtor byas la// de nas lag pa g.yon bkab/ oṃ yig gis sbyang bar bya'o/ lag pa g.yas bkab/ āḥyig gis rtogs par bya'o/ snyim pa bkab ste/ hūm̐ yig gis sbar bar bya'o/ mkha' lding gi phyag rgya dang*/ hoḥyig gis zhu ba dang bdud rtsir bya'o/ hūm̐/ dbyings srid zhi kun tu 'char ba'i ma// dpal rdo rje yan lag ma mo'i 'phrul// mtshan kun ldan ye shes kā pa la// de bsam gyi mi khyab nam mkha' tsam// ā ra li rnal 'byor gyi 'dus pa la// 'dod yon gyi longs spyod mi zad pa// ha hoḥhriḥkha dog dri ro'i tshogs// mchog rnam pa kun ldan stong pa'i dpyid// oṃ āḥhūm̐ sbyangs rtogs sbar bas na// dpal mi 'gyur bde ba chen po'i gnas// sa ha dza so so rang rig gis/ kha sbyor gyi 'khor lo gcig tu sdom/ /zhes byin gyis brlabs te/ chang gi thig les g.yon pa'i ming med kyi rtse mos sa la chos 'byung gru gsum byas la/ de'i dbus su thig le ltar zlum por bskor la/ hūm̐/ thugs zung 'jug rgyal ba kun gyi dngos// gsung chos kyi 'khor lo thams cad pa// sku rnam pa kun ldan tshogs kyi mchog /skyabs gsum gyi 'dus pa bla ma rje// 'khor brgyud pa'i bla ma nyi li li// sku mdzes pa'i rus rgyan khro lo lo// gsung theg chen chos sgra 'u ru ru// thugs dgyes pa'i gar stabs ling nge nge*// nged bu slob tshogs kyi dpon la gshegs// bcud dam rdzas rnams la byin rlabs zhu// mchog thun mong dngos grub gnang nas kyang*// yab khyed dang mnyam pa'i dngos grub zhu// dkyil 'khor gyi pad+ma'i snying po kun// ris med pa rgyal ba'i ze'u 'brus bkang*// dngos grub kyi zil mngar ci dang ci// yid bzhin du 'byung ba lhag pa'i lha// 'khor yi dam lha tshogs nyi li li// sku=

gsung= thugs= nged= bcud= mchog= lha khyed dang mnyam pa'i dngos grub zhu// nang ye shes nyi ma zla ba'i rdzu// bar chad kyi mun pa mthar byed cing*// yid skyob kyi snang ba kun ston pa// yum rdo rje btsun mo rigs lnga'i sde// 'khor= sku= gsung= thugs= nged= bcud= mchog= ma khyed dang mnyam pa'i dngos grub zhu/ khong bdud bzhi'i g.yul ngo rlag byed du// dpal rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i snying rje'i stobs// lha mi bzad khros pa dpa' bo'i sde// mgon ma hā kā la lcam dral rnams// 'khor dregs pa'i lha srin nyi li li// sku= gsung= thugs= nged= bcud= mchog= mgon khyed dang mnyam pa'i dngos grub zhu/ /zhes spyan drangs nas/ chos 'byung nam mkha'i khams khyab pa tsam du songs ba'i steng gi char bla ma/ 'og gi char yi dam bsgom pa bzhin la gsang sngags kyi lha thams cad gnas gsum gyi mkha' 'gro dang mkha' 'gro ma/ 'og tu dam pa chos skyong ba'i srung ma zhing skyong pho mo'i tshogs kyis bskor nas bzhugs par bsam la/ las kyis rdo rjes phyag gsum btsal/ tshogs phud dang po 'bul ba la thugs gtad par zhu byas la/ hūm̐/ rje srid zhi'i phan pa thams cad du// chu zla bzhin 'gog pa med shar ba// dpal dang po'i mgon po bla ma'i zhabs// bka' brgyud kyi rje btsun rgya mtsho la// mi bdag gi lus dge longs spyod kun// sngags gsang ba chen po'i dam tshig rdzas// ci spyad kyang mi zad nam mkha'i mdzod// 'dod yon gyi dpyid du sbar te 'bul// tshogs gnyis kyi lang tsho rab gang zhing*// sgrib gnyis kyi sprin las rnam grol ba'i// dpal kun tu bzang po'i 'od zer ni// nam mkha' srid 'gengs pa'i nus pa zhu/ tshogs phud gnyis pa la/ oṃ shrī badz+ra he he ru ru kam̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ ḍā ki ni dzā la sam̐ ba raṃ swā hā/ oṃ hrīḥha ha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ ga ṇa tsakra pū dza khā hi/ oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī ye badz+ra war+ṇa nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ swā hā/

oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ swā hā/ ga ṇa tsakra pū dza khā hi/ oṃ ḍā ki nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ lā ma ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ khaṇ+ḍa ro hi hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ru pi nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ ga ṇa tsakra pū dza khā hi/ oṃ ka ra ka ra khaṇ+ḍa ka pā la/ pra tsaṇ+ḍe hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ku ru ku ru ma hā kaṃ kā la/ tsaṇ+ḍa k+ṣi ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ban+dha ban+dha kaṃ kā la/ pra bha wa ti ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ trā sa ya trā sa ya bi ga ṭa daṃṣ+ṭā/ ma hā nā s+ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ ga ṇa tsakra pū dza khā hi/ oṃ k+ṣo bha ya k+ṣo bha ya sū ra wā+ai ti/ bī ra ma tī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ hrauṃ hrauṃ a mṛ ta bha ba/ kharba rī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ hra hra badz+ra pra bha wa/ laṅke shwa rī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ pheṃ faiṃ badz+ra de ha dru mats+tsha ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ ga ṇa tsakra pū dza khā hi/ oṃ phaṭ phaṭ aṅku rī ka/ e rā ba tī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ da ha da ha badz+ra dza ṭi la ma hā bhai ra wi hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ pa tsa pa tsa ma hā wi ra wā yu be ge hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ bhak+ṣa bhak+ṣa ba sa ru dhi rān+t+ra mā lā wa lam+bi ni badz+ra hūm̐ ka ra/ su ra bhak+ṣi nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ ga ṇa tsakra pū dza khā hi/ oṃ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa sap+ta pā tā la ga ta bhu dzaṅgaṃ sarbaṃ bā tardza ya tardza ya su bha dra/ sh+yā ma de wī hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ā kaḍ+ḍh+ya ā kaḍ+ḍh+ya badz+ra pra bha su bha dre hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ hrīṃ hrīṃ ma hā bhai ra ba/ ha yā kar+ṇe hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ dzaṇauṃ dzaṇauṃ bi rū pāk+ṣa/ kha gā na ne hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ ga ṇa tsakra pū dza khā hi/ oṃ k+ṣ+māṃ k+ṣ+māṃ ma hā ba la/ tsakra be ge hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ hāṃ hāṃ rat+na badz+ra khaṇ+ḍa ro he hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ hīṃ hīṃ ha ya gṛ ba/ shauṇ+ḍī nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ ā ka sha gar+bha tsakra warmi nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/

ga ṇa tsakra pū dza khā hi/ oṃ ki li ki li he ru ka/ su bī rī hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ si li si li pad+ma nirti shwa ra/ ma hā ba le hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ hi li hi li bai ro tsa na/ tsakra war+t+ti nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ dhi li dhi li badz+ra satwa/ ma hā bīr+ya ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ ga ṇa tsakra pū dza khā hi/ oṃ kā kā s+ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ u lū kā s+ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ shwa nā ka s+ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ sū ka rā s+ye hūm̐ hūm̐/ ga ṇa tsakra pū dza khā hi/ oṃ ya ma da dhī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ya ma dū ti ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ya ma daṃṣ+ṭi ṇi ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ya ma ma thā ni ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ ga ṇa tsakra pū dza khā hi/ bar lha sngags bzhi re'i mtshams/ ga ṇa tsakra pū dza khā hi btags pas dkyil 'khor la phul/ gsum pa la/ hūm̐/ zhi ba dang khro chags thams cad pa// sgyu 'phrul gyi zlos gar la shar nas// dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo'i mgon mdzad pa// yi dam gyi lha tshogs rgya mtsho la// mi bdag gi= sngags gsang ba= ci spyad kyang= 'dod yon gyi= tshogs gnyis kyi= sgrib gnyis kyi= dpal kun tu= nam mkha' srid/ de man sngar bzhin phul/ bzhi pa/ 'khor 'das kyi ngo mtshar ma lus pa// gnyis med las gnyis su ston mdzad pa'i// sras rgyal ba thams cad skyed pa'i yum// dpa' bo dang ḍā ki rgya mtsho la// mi bdag gi= sngags gsang ba= ci spyad kyang= 'dod yon gyi= tshogs gnyis kyi= sgrib gnyis kyi= dpal kun tu= nam mkha' srid= lnga pa/ bdud tshogs la bdud dang chos par gnyen// snying rje las rnam pa thams cad pa// khrag 'thung gi rgyal po dga' mar bcas// dam can gyi chos skyong rgya mtsho la// mi bdag gi lus dge longs spyod kun// sngags gsang ba chen po'i dam tshig rdzas// ci spyad kyang mi zad nam mkha'i mdzod// 'dod yon gyi dpyid du sbar te 'bul// tshogs gnyis kyi lang tsho rab gang zhing*// sgrib gnyis kyi sprin las rnam grol ba'i// dpal kun tu bzang po'i 'od zer ni// nam mkha' srid 'gengs pa'i nus pa zhu/

zhes pas phul/ oṃ yig dang dbus su ming / yul 'di'i gzhi bdag gnas bdag grong bdag gnyug mar gnas pa rnams la oṃ āḥhūm̐/ i daṃ ba liṃ ta gṛh+ṇa sarba satwā nāṃ shan+tiṃ tsit+ta ku ru ku ru swā hā/ yul de'i zhing skyong dang grong gi bdag po la/ dbus su ming zhes pa/ de dag gi ming 'bru bzhi yod na mnyam pas yi ge dang po ming yin pas de 'jug /gsum na mi mnyam pa la gsum pa ming du 'gyur bas de 'jug pa yin no/ des 'gre'o/ oṃ hā rī ti paṇ+ḍi ke pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ 'phrog ma'i changs bu'i sngags/ oṃ dū tī ke a grā gra saṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes bsngags nas bza' ba'i mtha' ji srid pa la bzhag go /de nas las kyi rdo rjes bza' ba sder du 'bul zhing btung ba pad+ma'i snod du phul te bskor ba gsum byas nas/ dri dang*/ bdug pa dang me tog la sogs pa rnams kyis mchod nas gsol ba gdab par bya ste/ bsod nams 'di yis sems can thams cad phyag rgya chen po'i ye shes thob par gyur cig /ces pas so/ de nas longs spyod/ brtag gnyis bzhin rdo rje'i glu dang gar bya/ lhag ma bsdus/ rdo rje slob dpon gyis 'bar ba'i phyag rgya dang bcas pas kha phru btab ste/ hūm̐/ ma rdo rje btsun mo khros pa'i gzugs// 'khor gnas dang pho nya 'jig rten pa// dam tshig dang sha za'i ḍā ki ma// mdangs dkar ser dmar ljang sngo dang khra/ lus glog 'khyug me dpung 'u ru ru// ngag bshug glu zhud po di ri ri// yid sangs rgyas bstan la dung nge nge*// las srid gsum myul la sha ra ra// mtho nam mkha'i dbyings nas bya ra byed// dam nyams pa'i steng du thog tu 'bab// bar dur khrod kun tu rgyu zhing 'phur// dgra tho lum 'bar ba'i ro ru za// dma' rgya mtsho'i klong nas gyen la rgyug /mi dam nyams bsgral nas khrag la 'thung*// nad brgyad khri bzhi stong kun gyi bdag

/pho mtshar po kun gyi snying la 'jug /mo mchor mo thams cad zhe yis gnon// gnas dben par sgom pa'i drod tshad myul/ khyod dgyes pa'i lhag gtor bshams nas 'bul// nged skal ldan dga' ba'i dngos grub zhu// oṃ uts+tshiṣ+ṭa bhak+ṣa bh+yaḥswā hā/ tshogs zhing gtor mgron ye shes pa oṃ khyed kyis sogs rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgyas rang ngam rten la bsdu/ 'jig rten pa sarba gats+tshas se gol brdabs te gshegs// gzhon nu ma'i tshogs kyi mchod pa yang nus na bya'o/ he ru ka yi sogs/ he ru ka yi dkyil 'khor du// tshogs kyi 'khor los mchod pa yis// bdag gzhan 'gro ba ma lus pa// dkyil 'khor gcig tu 'grub par shog /nyes ltung dri mas ma gos shing*// rlabs chen spyod pa rdzogs pa dang*// he ru ka dang mnyam pa yi// go 'phang tshe 'dir thob gyur cig /'khor 'das kun gyis dus gsum bsags pa dang*// yod pa'i dge ba ma lus gcig bsdus te// bde chen byang chub mchog gi dkyil 'khor du// sku gsum rgyal srid chen po thob phyir bsngo/ de nas dkyil 'khor la mchod bstod bsdus pa bya ba ste// oṃ āḥbadz+ra ar+ghaṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ pa d+yaṃ= añtsa ma naṃ= puṣ+pe= dhu pe= dī paṃ= gan+dhe= nai wid+ya= shap+ta hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid// skad cig nyid la 'char ba gang*// bla ma rin chen lta bu'i sku// rdo rje can zhabs pad la 'dud// bcom ldan mgon po dpa' bo'i dbang phyug ni// bskal pa'i me chen lta bur rab tu 'bar// ral pa'i cod pan dbu yi rgyan du bcings// mche ba rab gtsegs drag shul rngam pa'i zhal// sku la phyag stong gzi brjid ldan pa po// dgra s+t+wa zhags pa khaṭ+wām̐ mdung bsnams shing*// rab 'jigs stag gi pags pa gos su gyon// sku chen dud kha bgegs mthar mdzad la 'dud// bcom ldan 'das ma rdo rje phag mo 'phags ma ni// 'jig rten gsum sogs phyogs gzhan rgol bas mi thub cing*// 'byung po'i 'jigs pa ma lus rdo rje chen mos 'joms// rdo rje gdan bzhugs tshangs sogs 'byor chen mo 'dod pa'i dbang phyug ma la 'dud// dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ni// mkha' 'gro ma yi 'khor lo sgyur// ye shes lnga dang sku gsum nyid// 'gro ba skyob la phyag 'tshal lo// ji snyed rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// kun tu rtog pa'i 'ching gcod cing*// 'jig rten bya ba rab 'jug ma// de snyed rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod// oṃ shrī he ru ka sa ma ya ma nu pā la ya/

shrī he ru ka twe no pa tiṣ+ṭha dṛḍho me bha wa/ su toṣ+yo me bha wa/ a nu rak+to me bha wa/ su poṣ+yo me bha wa/ sarba sid+dhi m+mepra yats+tsha/ sarba karma su tsa me tsit+taṃ shre yaḥku ru hūm̐/ ha ha ha ha hoḥ bha ga wān sarba ta thā ga ta he ru ka mā me muñtsa/ he ru ka bha wa/ ma hā sa ma ya satwa āḥ bzod par gsol ba/ ma 'byor pa= lhag pa= khyed la mchod= bla ma sku khams= 'jig rten bde= 'jig rten 'di'am= rdul tshon yin na/ bdag dang 'gro la thugs brtse'i phyir// nyid kyi rdzu 'phrul mthu yis ni// ji srid mchod pa bdag bgyid pa// de srid bcom ldan bzhugs su gsol// pad+ma ka ma lā ya s+t+waṃ/ ras bris yin na 'dir ni gzugs dang sogs kyis brtan bzhugs bya bdag bskyed bsdu ldang dang dge ba bsngo/ shis pa brjod/ ༄༅// dkyil 'khor bsdu chog nyin/ snying ga nas spros pa'i mchod pa'i lha mo mchod rdzas bsam gyis mi khyab pa thogs pa rnams kyis/ oṃ shrī he ru ka pra war sat+ka ra ma hā ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha hūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ shrī he ru ka ma hā pa d+yaṃ ma ma tat+taṃ gṛh+ṇa sid+dhi m+me pra yats+tsha hūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ shrī he ru ka sa tuṅka pra tits+tsha hūm̐ swā hā/ dkyil 'khor kun tu rgyal ba mnyes byed pa// gzugs mdzes dkar mo rdo rje dril bu dang*// me tog spungs pa'i rin chen snod 'dzin ma// nam mkha' gang bas dkyil 'khor lha tshogs mchod// oṃ āḥbadz+ra puṣ+pe hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ dkyil 'khor kun tu= yid 'ong dud kha= bdug spos 'thul= nam mkha' gang= oṃ āḥbadz+ra dhu pe= dkyil 'khor kun tu= kun snang dmar ser= mar mes gang= nam mkha' gang= oṃ āḥbadz+ra di paṃ= dkyil 'khor kun tu= gdung sel ljang gu= dri mchog byug= nam mkha' gang= oṃ āḥbadz+ra gan+dhe= dkyil 'khor kun tu= zhal zas sna tshogs= bdud rtsis gang= nam mkha' gang= oṃ āḥbadz+ra nai wi d+yā= dkyil 'khor kun tu= sgra snyan sna tshogs=

rab 'jug ma// de snyed rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod// oṃ shrī he ru ka sa ma ya=

ma hā sa ma ya satwa āḥ ma 'byor pa dang= lhag pa dang ni= khyed la mchod bstod= bla ma sku khams= phan bde 'byung ba'i= chos rnga chen po'i= 'jig rten bde zhing= 'jig rten 'di'am= thams cad nam mkha'= byang chub sems mchog= klu rgyal dga' bo nye dga' bo// gzhan yang grong khyer gnas pa dag /tshe ring nad med phun sum tshogs// gtan tu bde ba thob par shog /bdag sogs rnams= dge ba 'di yi= 'khor lo sdom pa 'grub= 'gro ba gcig kyang= de yi sa la 'god par shog /mdun bskyed kyi lha tshogs rnams 'dir ni rten dang= oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swā hā/

zhes pas rten gsum la bstim te rab gnas mdzad pa phyag rgyun la bzhugs shing gzhan du na gshegs su gsol ba sogs kun mkhyen gsung bzhin skabs dang bstun no/ 2 ༒ /rdul tshon a kā ro 'i sngags brjod cing ku shas 'phyag /dri bzang po'i chus thig dbyi bum chu dang lhan cig blugs/ rgyal mtshan la sogs pa'i mchod pa dang gdugs phub rten khebs kyis g.yogs te/ 'bab chu'am chu mig tu spyan drangs/ der tshom bu dgu pa mtha' nyer mchod dang dkar gsum mngar gsum gyi gtor ma bsham/ khaṇ+ḍa ro his bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs tshom bu'i dkyil 'khor mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las phuḥdagu las/ chu bdag wa ru ṇa la klu chen po brgyad kyis bskor ba/ de thams cad stod lha'i gzugs thal mo sbyar ba/ gdengs ka bdun pa/ smad sbrul gyi mjug ma rkan ris khra bo/ rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ lcags kyu'i phyag rgya bcas la/ oṃ nā ga rā dza sa pa ri wa re sa ma ya hūm̐ dza dzaḥ spyan drangs pa dang gnyis su med par gyur/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra ar+ghaṃ nas/ puṣ+pe sogs/ shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum/ oṃ a kā ro= lan gsum/ mtha' yas dang ni 'jog po dang*// stobs kyi rgyu dang rigs ldan dang*// nor rgyas dang ni dung skyong dang*// pad+ma dang ni dpal gyi 'od// chu bdag 'khor dang bcas pa rnams// mdzes pa'i dkar gsum gtor ma dang*// mngar gsum 'o ma'i rgya mtsho che// rin chen phreng ba'i them skas can// klu yi gnod pa skyob byed pa// mthun pa'i rdzas su 'di 'bul lo// gces pa'i rin chen 'di snoms la// bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa dang*// 'gro ba sems can thams cad kyi// 'dod pa'i don kun grub par mdzod// ma 'byor pa sogs/ gong gi dkyil 'khor bsdu chog skabs ltar la/ klu rgyal dga' bo 'i mtha' bar/ rdul tshon rin po che'i rgyur rgya mtsho chen por bsnams te gshegs par gyur/

sarba gats+tsha se gol brdab bo/ de ltar snyan brgyud kyi smin lam gyi cho ga rgyas pa rtsa bshad kyi rgyud kyi 'khrug sdebs tshul la mkha' 'gro mas gsang ba byin pa pad+ma dkar pos tsa ri tra'i gnas sgo byar yul gyi dbus na mor sbyar ba'i/ yi ge pa ni rin chen bstan pa rgyal mtshan no// 'di'i dge bas thams cad rdo rje theg par 'jug par gyur cig /// bden pa min pa rnams kyi rgyud bcad nas// bden nges khrims kyi srol lugs cher sgrog pa// bden don grangs las gcig dman mgrin pa can// bden smra pad+ma dkar po srong btsan bzhin// / sarba maṅga laṃ// ༒ snyan brgyud rdo rje rnal 'byor ma zhes bya ba bzhugs so// /rgya gar skad du/ karna tan+t+ra badz+ra yo gi nī nā ma/ bod skad du/ snyan brgyud rdo rje rnal 'byor ma zhes bya/ bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje 'chang la phyag 'tshal lo// e ma ho/ sangs rgyas kun gyi yang dag gsang ba mchog /bde chen rgyal po thig le mchog gi lam// tshig tu brjod pa kun dang bral ba'i don// theg chen skye med rang sgra 'di skad thos// rdo rje 'chang ngas skal ldan don du bshad// gus btud nas ni ye shes mkha' 'gro nyon// bslab gsum brgyud ldan nyams myong bla ma mchog /dad brtson shes rab snying rje'i slob ma 'o// nyes dmigs dran pas tshe 'di'i bya ba btang*// thog mar 'khor lo sdom pa la brten nas// drug cu rtsa gnyis dkyil 'khor dbang bzhi bskur// lha mo bco lnga dbang bzhi brda yis mtshon// smin par byas nas thabs shes zung du sbrel// rgyal po blon dmangs rnal 'byor bdun la 'bad// bsre ba ro snyoms dam tshig gsum la sbyar// gtum mo bde drod rang 'bar lam gyi gzhung*// lus gnad bdun ldan lha sku stong ra gnad// dhu tī la la ra sā 'khor lo bzhi// a haṃ 'bar 'dzag srog rtsol thur sel gcud// rdo rje'i bzlas pa rtsa ba'i rlung lnga bsgom/

zin dang brtan pas shes rab snyoms par 'jug /dga' bzhir goms pas rtsa rlung thig ler bsre// dhu tīr rlung sems tshud pas mi rtog pa// nyon mongs rang zhi bde gsal rgyun mi 'chad// ngo bo mthong nas chos sku'i ngang du gnas// bogs 'don sgyu lus chos brgyad rang grol ni// 'khor 'das thams cad sgyu mar shes bya ste// sgyu ma'ang 'ja' tshon chu zla lta bu'o// 'di ltar snang ba'i dngos po'i chos rnams ni// bden zhing rtag na 'gyur bar ga la rigs// 'khrul gzugs yin phyir don la grub pa med// gzugs rnams snang stong sgra rnams brag char ltos// gnyis snang zhig pas chags sdang kun dang bral// de ltar shes pas sna tshogs 'dzin med spyod// 'ja' lus chos kyi sku ni thob par 'gyur// mtshan dus rmi lam 'khrul pa rang sangs ni// sgo gsum 'bad pas dran pa'i lcags kyus bzung*// zin sbyang spel bsgyur sprul zhing gegs rnams bsal// nyi zla zhon nas zhing khams mtha' dag bgrod// bzang ngan sgyu ma cir snang rang grol 'gyur// mthar phyin sa bcu non nas bde chen thob/ khyad par 'od gsal ma rig mun bral ni// lus gnad thabs ldan ting 'dzin bzhi la sbyar// thig ler gus ldan dug gsum 'dzin med ltos// gnyid dang rmi lam rnam rtog bar nas bzung*// rim pa bzhin dang nyin mtshan bsre zhing bsgom// gsal stong 'dzin bral lhan skyes ye shes te// brjod du med pa'i 'od gsal rgyun mi 'chad// ma rtogs sbyang zhing phyag rgya chen por blta// 'pho ba gser 'gyur ma bsgoms sangs rgyas ni// 'chi ltas shar tshe dga' zhing zhen pa gtong*// sgo dgu bkag la rdzas dang smon lam brgyan// hūm̐ dang rlung sems dbyer med dhū tīr drang*// k+ṣa yig gsal la tshangs pa'i lam nas 'phang*// chos sku bla ma rgyal ba'i zhing du 'pho// lhag par grong 'jug sbrul lpags 'dor len ni// rlung sems dbang thob bskyed rdzogs brtan pa yis// skyon med ro la rnam shes yig 'bru 'phang*// dus yul rdzas dang grogs gnad mngon du gyur// the tshom bral ba'i skyes bus gzhan don spyod// mkha' 'gro'i gsang sgrog bde ba chen po ni// bcu gcig nyer lnga'i bar gyi rig ma dag

/pad+ma ri dwags dung can la sogs pa'i// phyag rgya mtshan ldan rdo rje rnal 'byor ma// skal ldan skyes bu he ru ka ru blta// gnyis med 'khril sbyor zag bcas zag med rol// thig le dbab gzung ldog dgram gnas su spel// dga' ba bzhi gsum bcu gnyis don la blta// lhan skyes ye shes rang bzhin dbyer med ston// snang srid thams cad zag med bde bar 'char// gsang ba phyag rgya bdud rtsi'i ril bu'i phyir// thig le bcu drug phyed phyed bzhi cha sbyin// bzhi gsum 'khor lo dag la dgram par bya// bag med 'dod sred gzhan dbang chang gis myos// don las nyams shing slar yang ngan song ltung*// des na rdo rje'i lus la gnad du bsnun// tshe 'dir sangs rgyas ster bar the tshom med// phyag rgya chen po ye shes gsal byed ni// sgo gsum g.yo med sgo lnga har gdangs bzhag /bltas pas mthong med sems kyi mtshan nyid ltos// dmigs su med pas ma bcos rang sar zhog /gzhan du ma tshol ngo bo rtogs par gyis// gzhi gnas ma bcos ye nas lhun grub la// tha mal rang lugs chen por bzhag pa na// 'pho 'gyur med pa nam mkha'i klong yangs su// skye shi med pa chos sku'i lus thob 'gyur// phyi rol yul sems chos rnams ji snyed pa// rang sems yin phyir gzhan du grub pa med// 'khrul rtog gnyis 'dzin rnam pa gang shar yang*// cir snang gzhi med rang byung rang la ltos// sems nyid skye med stong pa chos kyi sku// 'gag med gsal dwangs gang shar sprul pa'i sku// gnas med bde chen zung 'jug longs spyod rdzogs// phyag ni gnyis med ye shes ngo yis zin// rgya ni 'khor ba'i mdud pa grol ba ste// chen po zung 'jug sgron me bltams pa la// gzhan gyis ma yin rang grol chos sku'o// sgrib gnyis rang dag gzung 'dzin mtha' dang bral// 'du shes blo dang 'khor 'das chos rnams zad// mkhyen brtse'i yon tan ji snyed rang la rdzogs// bsam brjod blo 'das sangs rgyas rang 'khrungs yin// bar do ngo sprod yang dag zab don bstan// skye shi rmi lam srid pa'i bar do gcod// bltar med bltas pas mthong med mthong ba'i mchog

/rang rig gsal stong mi rtog sgrib g.yogs bral// bde chen chos dbyings ye shes rnam par dag /rang bzhin dbyer med sku gsum rang shar ltos// ma rtogs lus ldan bar do rnam gsum la// bskyed rim sgyu lus 'od gsal chos sku bsre// sa chu me rlung 'byung ba rim gyis thim// brgyad cu 'gags nas snang ba gsum 'das te// dkar dmar sems gsum chu skyes nang du 'dzom// 'od gsal ngos zin ma bu dbyer med 'dres// chos skur 'tshang rgya dbang po yang rab bo// de ma zin na rlung gsum rkyen gyis 'ching*// 'bring po chu las nya ltar longs skur ldang*// rtsal lnga zer lnga dug gsum las kyi dbang*// chags sdang gnyis kyis mngal du 'jug gyur na// bsre ba lnga ldan lam khyer phyag rgya bzhi// sngar sbyang ldan pas bar do rang grol 'gyur// tha ma chags sdang grol nas sprul sku thob// gdams pa spyi la gegs bsal bdud ngos gzungs// rtsa ba drug la yan lag so dgu yi// rdo rje'i lus kyi 'khrul 'khor gnad du bsnun// bya spyod thams cad tshogs su bsgyur bar bya// go rim ji bzhin nyams su blangs gyur na// skad cig bzhi yis dga' ba gsum son te// dwangs ma yas byon 'gyur med mas brtan pas// rtsa mdud rim par grol nas dhū tīr 'gyur// nyi khri chig stong drug brgya rtsa ba lnga'i// rlung dang nyon mongs 'gags nas ye shes 'gyur// gnas dang nye gnas nyi shu bzhi la sogs// pul+li ra ma man chad gang bar 'gyur// sprul sku longs sku la sogs zhal mthong zhing*// mngon shes yon tan brgya dang rab bkram thob// dus 'dir sa lam rim par bgrod byas te// rdo rje 'dzin pa'i go 'phang thob par 'gyur// bcu gsum bar du chig brgyud rgya yis btab// mdo rgyud kun gyi snying po 'di yin pas// skal ldan grol phyir gsang ba'i nges don mdzod// ces ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma la gdams pa snyan rgyud rdo rje rnal 'byor ma zhes bya ba rdzogs so// rgya gar gyi mkhas pa nā ro paṇa chen gyi zhal snga nas dang*// bod kyi lo tsā ba mar pa chos kyi blo gros kyis puṣ+pa ha ri'i gnas chen du bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o// ༒

rje ngag dbang bzang po'i gsol 'debs yid kyi mun sel bzhugs so// dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi thugs rje'i 'phrul// skye dgu'i mos pa ji ltar der shar nas// gdul bya kun mkhyen sa la 'god mdzad pa'i// rje btsun bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// gnas tshul gdod ma'i dbyings der khyab gdal ba// snang tshul gdul bya'i ngo na sdom gsum ldan// nyes ltung dri mas ma gos btsun pa'i mchog /rje btsun bla ma'i zhabs= kun mkhyen 'brug pa'i zhabs pad thod bzhin du// mdzad pas byin rlabs 'pho ba'i dbang thob nas// snying po'i don la skrag pa mi mnga' ba'i// rje btsun bla ma'i zhabs= spang bya 'khor ba'i chos dang mya ngan 'das// dbyer med ro mnyam gyur pa'i brtul zhugs kyis// nyon mongs bdud bzhi'i dpung rnams 'joms mdzad pa'i// rje btsun bla ma'i zhabs= de ltar rtse gcig gus pas gsol 'debs na// gdul bya'i 'khor gyi re ba ma rdzogs bar// rje btsun bla mas rjes su nyer bzung nas// chos nyid mngon sum rtogs pa'i bka' drin stsol// ༒ na ma tsa kra saṃ bha ra ya/ sgyu 'phrul sna tshogs gzugs brnyan me long du// zhi chags khro bo'i rol rtsed thams cad pa// dkyil 'khor 'khor lor shar ba bde ba'i mchog /rnam kun bde ba'i rol rtsed mdzad der 'dud// snying rje'i gang ba bcu drug cha rdzogs pa// gzung 'dzin rnam rtog gcod pa'i mtshon cha can// dag pa'i chos kyi ri mor chags pa'i dpyid// rdo rje yan lag ma yis skyong gyur cig /rdul bral stong pa'i rang gzugs rnam mang po'i// mos pa la chags mtho ris sa dang ni// sa 'og gnas kyi 'khor los sgyur ba po// gnyis med dpa' bo ḍā ki'i tshogs la bstod// rang rig ye shes dbyings su dbyer med kyang*// ma rtogs gdul bya'i mos pa ltar snang ba'i// dkyil 'khor mchod bsnyen gsang rgyud bklag pa'i mthus// gdod ma'i khrag 'thung mgon po khyod 'grub shog

/lus ngag yid dang ye shes snyigs ma'i khams// sgrib bral mi shigs thig ler sbyangs pa yis// rdo rje gsum gyi gsang ba mngon byang chub// sku gsum 'bras bu smin pa'i mchog thob shog /gzhi yi gnas lugs phung po lnga'i dri ma// nyon mongs ye shes lnga ru lam khyer bas// 'bras bu bde gshegs lnga yi rang bzhin du// yongs su grol ba'i lam gyis tshim gyur cig /mnyam yangs dbu ma'i lam gyi 'khor lo la// thabs shes nyi zla'i bgrod pa yongs rdzogs nas// zung 'jug phyag rgya chen po'i rol rtsed la// 'gog med rdo rje 'dzin pa'i dpal thob shog /de ltar sdom pa'i rnal 'byor la gzhol ba'i smon lam 'di ni skyabs mchog dge legs bzhad pa'i dpal gyi gsung gi gsang ba'o//
